chapters: Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel baap gu Ejipto bɨɨx gu Jakob; gio ba' maa'n chɨbiapui bɨɨx ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' gu Rubeen gu Simeoon gu Lebii gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' gu Issakâr gu ñi'ook gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' gu Dan gu chuukug gu Gad gu Aser.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ moor gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jakob jix bɨɨx duu gu vaak; gio ba' gu Josee ka't gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Josee bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨx mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' jix mui' jix bɨɨx duu gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix bhuup gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix búup kapbhai' jix vɨɨk gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Ejipto cham gu suudai' gu Josee; gio ba' jix aa' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix gɨ' gu oi'ñga'n jix kavɨk no'ch.
Na gu' jano' tu'ch mamatdagɨm na ba' bɨɨx na gu' cham gu suudai' gu ñi'ook bai'ñpu' bhɨɨ'ñdham gio gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu suudai' bhaan no'ch gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix dhaas bhaan jugi bopxi'ñ gu suudai' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Faraoon jɨ'dɨlh gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu Raamses.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n jix mui' gu takarui'; na ba' mi'p gu oi'ñga'n gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n jix duu tu juan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu oidha' bɨɨx gu jodai' juantu'n gu chuukug bhi'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook yooxi' bɨx gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' bɨɨx gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto baasɨ'n gu ebreas jup tɨɨt gu Sipra gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk baasɨ'n gu ebreas gu suudai' gu chuukug tu' ka't gu mar gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' tu' ka't mar u'vɨ jano' ba' gu tai.
Gu' gu' baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham jix duu na ja'p jix aa'ñdhix gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oidha' a'aalh.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto jix duu tɨɨt baasɨ'n; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook dhi' jix duñia' gu suudai' gu oidha' a'aalh.
Jano' ba' baasɨ'n tu ñi'ook gu Faraoon; na gu' gu u'vɨ gu ebreas cham na ja'p gu Egipkias; na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ va'k baasɨ'n gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix mui' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ux gu suudai' baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Faraoon jix aa'ñdhix bɨx gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' mi'x juu'ñ gɨ' suudai' jiim bɨx gu mar gu takarui' bɨx mar u'vɨ jix duñia' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ ja'tkam vaak gu Lebii ka't jix bhɨɨ gu ux gu u'vɨ mar u'vɨ gu Lebii.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu mar; gio ba' gu chuukug ka't jix duñia' gu jodai' na jix uam vaik masaa'n.
Gu' gu' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bɨɨx gu vatop gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix dhaas gu ñi'ook jugii'ñ gɨ' suudai' jiim.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu jodai' gu suudai' na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' mar u'vɨ gu Faraoon jix dhaav jix duñia' gɨ' suudai' jiim gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' gu ux gu vaak gɨ' suudai' jiim jix ñi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook bhañ gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu jodai' jix bhɨɨ.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix kupi'ook jix ñi' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr da'p jugi jix aa'; jano' ba' a'aalh gu ebreos gu ux.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam mar u'vɨ gu Faraoon; gio ba' tu jiim mɨmɨim tɨɨt gu ebreas na ba' tu' gu jodai' dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mar u'vɨ gu Faraoon jix aa'; gio ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook jup tɨɨt gu naan gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' mar u'vɨ gu Faraoon; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n dhi' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' namkidha'; mi' dhɨr gu u'vɨ jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook jix duu.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ mar u'vɨ gu Faraoon jix duñia' jix dhaas gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Moisees bham; na gu' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu Moisees jix buus gu ja'tkam jix ñi' gu takarui'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Egipkio gu ñi'ook maa'n gu ebreos gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt ñɨi'ñ cham gu chuukug soo'mchulhdhak jix duñia' gu Egipkio jix duñia' oo'.
Ba' jix aa' jix buus gu tanoolh buimgidhak ñɨi'ñ gook gu ebreos gu suudai' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook tɨtmo.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' chɨkka tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ux gu ñi'ook jir bɨx bhai' bhaan no'ch gu bhóogɨt kooda' na ja'p gu bhóogɨt gu Egipkio jano' ba' gu Moisees jix duñia' ɨɨbhi'ñ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Faraoon dhi' gu chuukug jix duñia' kooda' gu Moisees; gu' gu Moisees jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Faraoon jix daa gu oidha' gu Madiaan; mi' dhɨr jix daa ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Madiaan kɨɨv ma'nkam u'uuvɨ tɨɨtɨs jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu suudai' na ba' jix bhuup gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug i'i kakneer gu taat.
Gu' gu' bipia'dam tɨɨtɨs mi'x juu'ñ; gio ba' jano' ba' gu Moisees jix búup jix duñia' gu ñi'ook kakneer.
Ba' jix aa' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' gu taat; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tɨbiap gu ñi'ook jootom.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu Egipkio jix duñia' gu novɨ bipia'dam gio jix buusñi gu suudai' gu ñi'ook kakneer.
Ba' jix aa' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; gio ba' duukat gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu takarui' gu chio'ñ mɨmɨim na ba' jugi gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees tɨ'ñcho jix koi bɨɨx mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ; gio ba' jix maa gu Moisees mar u'vɨ gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu mar jix dhaas gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Gersom; na gu' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' ka't mi' dhɨr mui'x gu tanoolh jix koi gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu jiim kuiñcha juantu'n tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ juantu'n.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n tɨ'ñcho ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Jakob.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Moisees kakneer gu Jetro jir bɨx bhai' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Madiaan jix duñia' kakneer gu suudai' oidha' jix gaki suudai' u'va gu oreb gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix ñi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios mɨmɨim gu tai tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux; gio ba' jix duñia' jix ñi' gu ux gu tanoolh gu tai gu ux cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees; gio ba' tu jiim tu' jano' gu oi'ñga'n dhi' jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook kuiñcha gu ux cham gu oi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa' ñɨi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jup tɨɨt gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux; gio ba' gu Moisees jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham tu' gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x; na gu' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook tɨɨt na gu' pai' tu' gu jodai' gu oidha' abhaar.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu taat gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam gu Jawatan Dios gu Isaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jakob; na gu' jano' ba' gu Moisees jix bhaan dhaas gu vupui na gu' jix duñia' ɨɨbhi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' xoi'kam buupui gu jodai' gu ja'tkam gu Ejipto naak tu ñi'ook kuiñcha gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' no'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' na ba' jix duñia' gu novɨ gu Egipkios jix buusñi mii' dhɨr gu oidha' jix bhai' gu ux na tu ibai' pai' gu takarui' bii'm gu ñi'ook pai' gu Kananeo gu takarui' gu Amorreo gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Jebuseo.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu' tɨbiap vupui bhaan tu' gio buupui gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Egipkise gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu kutun gu ux gu jodai' jano' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu Faraoon na ba' gu jodai' gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' chɨkka jix duñia' tu' na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Faraoon gu bhóogɨt gu Ejipto gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; na gu' tu' na gu' tu' jix duñia' bɨndak; mi' dhɨr dhi' tu' ka't gu ux nɨi'ñchudat tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' cham tu'x jai'ch jix buusñi dhi' gu ja'tkam gu Ejipto tu juan gu Jawatan Dios bhaan dhi' gu kavɨk.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios tattat tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Moisees: «Aañ jir Dhi' na jix jai'ch bɨɨx tas».

Ba' jix aa' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' daipu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tattat gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam gu Jawatan Dios gu Isaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jakob tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan; jano' ba' dhi' gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' bɨɨx tas dhi' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu kutun daraa gu Israeel gu takarui'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tattat gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Jakob jix ñi'ñ bham; mi' dhɨr tɨɨda' gu suudai' buupui duñia' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' jix buusñi gu jodai' gu Ejipto gu oidha' gu Kananeo gu takarui' gu Amorreo gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Jebuseo gu oidha' gu takarui' bii'm gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt tu' daraa gu Israeel gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu ebreos tu' gu takarui'; na ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' no'ch gu takarui' jano' gu bhóogɨt vaik gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto cham kiicha' tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu novɨ jix kavɨk.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu suudai' gu novɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Ejipto bɨɨx bɨx kɨɨ'p gu bhóogɨt jano' ba' kiicha' tu'.
Na pai' dhuuk tu' gu suudai' dhi' gu ja'tkam nɨidhidha' gu vupui gu Egipkios na ba' na pai' dhuuk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai'x.
Gu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu u'vɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux jix toja jodai gu ux jix uam jodai jajannulhi'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' bhaan gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Ejipto.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees; gio ba' gu suudai' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu chuukug; jano' ba' cham tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ux.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu oidha' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' gu Moisees gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' muuk gu novɨ gu ñi'ook gu ux gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu novɨ jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' gu ux gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tattat gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam gu Jawatan Dios gu Isaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jakob.
Ba' jix aa' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' jano' gu novɨ baaso; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu novɨ baaso; jano' ba' na ja'p jix buusñi gu suudai' gu novɨ ka't gu bhóogɨt na ja'p jabook.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu novɨ baaso; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu novɨ baaso; jano' ba' gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt baaso gu suudai' ka't gu bhóogɨt na ja'p gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham tu' gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook nɨi'ñchudat gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu' gu suudai' cham gu oi'ñga'n dhi' gook buimɨk tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ gu suudai' gɨ' suudai' jiim gu bhóogɨt gu oidha'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt mii' dhɨr gu suudai' jix bhɨɨ gɨ' suudai' jiim gu bhóogɨt gu ɨ'ɨr gu oidha'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan tu' cham jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' gu jodai' tu' gu suudai' dɨr tu' tu ñi'ook tu duukam; na gu' jix duñia' gu jodai' tu ñi'ook gu jodai' nɨɨn.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; gio ba' chɨkka jix maa gu chin gu chio'ñ chɨkka jix duu jix bhai'x tu' bai'ñchu' cham jix duñia' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' tu' jix duñia' gu chin tu' gu ñi'ook cham tu'x jai'ch ñiokda'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu jodai' gu tasi' gu novɨ tɨip.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios bhaam bhaan gu Moisees; gio ba' cham kakasnira' tu' xibhɨk gu Aaroon gu Lebita tu ñi'ook gu suudai' tu' gu jodai' gu takarui' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu chin gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' gu chin gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n bhaan.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ux tu' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu' ka't tu' pai' gu chin tu' ka' na ba' pai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ dhi' gu ux gu novɨ bɨɨx jix duu buimɨk.

Ba' jix aa' ka't gu Moisees gu ñi'ook jir bɨx bhai' gu Jetro; gio ba' tu jiim jano' gu jodai' gu ja'tkam gu Ejipto na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu suudai' gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr gu Jetro jix aa' gu Moisees; jano' ba' tu' bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gio gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Madiaan; na gu' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu Ejipto na gu' jix duñia' jix koi bɨx jix duñia' koi'm.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Moisees jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam jix dhaas bhaan gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oidha' gu Ejipto; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gio gu Moisees gu ux gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu Ejipto gu suudai' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Faraoon bɨx kɨɨ'p gu ñi'ook gu novɨ; mi' dhɨr tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ cham kiicha' tu' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' daipu' gu Faraoon; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Israeel gu mar maa'nkam mar.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook mi'x dhaas tu' gu mar na ba' gu takarui' gu' cham gu oi'ñga'n mi'x dhaas tu'; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kooda' gu mar maa'nkam mar.
Jano' ba' ka't gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' jix buus gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n kooda'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu mar mi'x juu'ñ tɨɨt bham; gio ba' tu'r tu' gu chuukug saabum gu ɨ'ɨr.
Jano' ba' mi'x dhaas tu'; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr saabum gu ɨ'ɨr kuiñcha matgilhdhix.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Aaroon; gio ba' tu' gu takarui' gu Moisees oidha' jix gaki; mi' dhɨr ka't jix duñia' gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Moisees gu Aaroon bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bɨx buimɨk ka't jix maa.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu Moisees gu Aaroon jum daa'ñ bɨx daraa gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Aaroon bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Moisees jix duu buimɨk vupui bhaan gu vupui gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix duñia'; gio ba' tɨiñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu suudai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel ka't buupui gu jodai' jix duñia' o'lhia.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr baap gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu Faraoon gui'p; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr mi'x dhaas tu' gu ja'tkam gu jodai' gu takarui' oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu Faraoon jix aa'; gio ba' chɨkka gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu' gu ñi'ook mi'x dhaas tu' gu Israeel tu' cham kakasnira' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu suudai' mi'x dhaas tu' gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ebreos tu' gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' jano' gu bhóogɨt vaik gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' cham gu oi'ñga'n bhaan no'ch bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu kuchii.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto; gio ba' gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu ux gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu suudai' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' gio gu Faraoon; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' jano' jix jai' gu takarui' xoi'kam gu suudai' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Faraoon mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam ko'kmarak gu chuukug gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' bham.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' cham jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam na ba' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu ñi'ook va'k gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix dhaas gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook duñia' va'k cham gu oi'ñga'n cham tu'; na gu' gu takarui' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook bham; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n juantu'n bhaan na ba' gu jodai' cham gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gamai' gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' tu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Faraoon; mi' dhɨr tu' cham gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ pai' gu ñi'ook; na cham tu' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam ja'aa gu ux bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu oi'ñga'n gu duukam pai' gu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jix duu bham; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu tanoolh na ja'p na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu takarui' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu bhóogɨt gu Faraoon gu suudai' gu ñi'ook bhaan bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook na ja'p va'k.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tɨɨtɨs gu Faraoon jix duñia' bham; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨɨx tu duukam.
Jano' ba' cham jix maa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu duukam bɨɨx bɨx tu ñi'ook; gio ba' xoi'kam gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' tu duukam gɨɨ'bia' gu ja'tkam gu suudai' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu takarui' gu ux gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jano' jix duñia'; gio ba' cham maa'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu takarui' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n cham tu' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu tanoolh.
Na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu Moisees gu Aaroon mi'p ñiata na pai' dhuuk jix buus gu Faraoon.

Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ñi'ook gu jodai'; na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n chulhiiñdha' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Faraoon tu duukam gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu noobh na ba' gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu ux gu ñi'ook gu suudai' dhi' gu ja'tkam na ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt.
Na gu' na gu' dɨr tu' gu jodai' gu Faraoon na ba' ñiokda' gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu' gu suudai' gu takarui' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' jano' gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu bhóogɨt gu Faraoon; na gu' bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk tu' mi'x dhaas tu'; jano' ba' bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk tu' mi'x juu'ñ gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Jakob gu suudai' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' gu' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gio dhi' ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx jix maa gu oidha' gu Kanaan gu oidha' jix bɨɨx duu gu suudai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' naak gu oi'ñga'n gu ma'nkam gu Israeel xoi'kam tu juan gu Egipkios gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' ñi'ook na jix bhaan.

Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' daipu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' jix buusñi bɨtaa'n gu takarui' gu Ejipto gu ñi'ook juantu'n gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx ñi'ook na jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ux gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu ux bɨtaa'n gu takarui' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha' gu ux gu chuukug gu novɨ gu ñi'ook gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Jakob; gio ba' tu' gu suudai' gu ux gu maa'nkar; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' dhi' gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gu' cham jix duñia' gu Moisees kuiñcha gu oi'ñga'n gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu jodai' juantu'n.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' ba'k tu ñi'ook gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto mi'x dhaas tu' gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Moisees vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Faraoon gu maa'nkar gu suudai' tu' gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon jix maa gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ba' gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto na ba' jix buusñi gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' dhi' ɨɨbhidham ja'tkam vaak tattat; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen maa'nkam mar gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu anok gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu esroon gu Karmi; jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Rubeen.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon; gio ba' gu Jemuel gu Jamiin gu Oad gu Jakîn gu Soar gu Sauul gu mar gu Kananea; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Simeoon.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu Gersoon gu Koat gu Merari; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' gu oidha' gu Lebii jix bɨɨx duu chamaam gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon; gio ba' gu Libni gu Simi gu ux ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koat; gio ba' gu Amram gu Isar gu ebroon gu Ussiel; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' gu oidha' gu Koat jix bɨɨx duu chamaam gu ñi'ook vaik gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Merari; gio ba' gu Maali gu Musi; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Lebii gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Amram jix bhɨɨ gu ux gu u'vɨ gu Jokêbed gu takarui'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Aaroon gu Moisees; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' gu oidha' gu Amram jix bɨɨx duu chamaam gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Isar; gio ba' gu Kora gu Nepeg gu Sitri.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ussiel; gio ba' gu Misael gu Elsapaan gu Sitri.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Aaroon gu ux gu u'vɨ gu Elisabet mar u'vɨ gu Aminadab gu ja'tkam gu Naasoon; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Nadab gu Abiuu gu Eleasar gu Itamar.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Kora; gio ba' gu Assir gu Elkana gu Abiasap; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Koritas.
Jano' ba' gu Eleasar gu mar gu Aaroon jix bhɨɨ na ba' gu u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu suudai' jix duñia' gu Pinees; gio ba' dhi' ɨɨbhidham tattat gu Lebitas gu ux ja'tkam vaak.
Ba' jix aa' dhi' mii' dhɨr gu Aaroon mii' dhɨr gu Moisees gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu takarui' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu ux gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam tu ñi'ook gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Ejipto gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Moisees gu Aaroon jix bɨɨx duu dhi' ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto bɨx tu'x tu' gu suudai' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' gu bhóogɨt gu Faraoon.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu Faraoon xibhɨk gu Aaroon ka't jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' tu' daipu' bɨx tu'x tu' jix aa'ñdhix gu Aaroon xibhɨk tu ñi'ook gu Faraoon na ba' mi'x dhaas tu' gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon gu jodai' gu oidha' gu Ejipto buimɨk kɨɨ'p.
Jano' ba' gu Faraoon cham gu bhóogɨt; gu' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ bhaan gu Ejipto jix buusñi chugi'ñ gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oidha' gu Ejipto bɨɨx ñi'ook na jir bhai'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu jodai' gu Egipkios tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' gu novɨ bhaan gu Ejipto jix buusñi gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees gu Aaroon na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix; gio ba' jix duu.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Moisees gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x gu takarui' gu Aaroon gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x vaik na pai' dhuuk tu ñi'ook gu Faraoon.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon bham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Faraoon tu ñi'ook bham jix duñia' gu ux; gio ba' daipu' gu Aaroon; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gu ux gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Faraoon na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu Faraoon jix duu na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Aaroon gu ux vupui bhaan gu Faraoon tu duukam jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gio gu Faraoon mamatdagɨm jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duu gio jix duñia' gu Ejipto bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt.
Na gu' jix duñia' maa'n gu ux suulh gu takarui'; gu' gu ux gu Aaroon jix duñia' gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon jix duñia' cham jix duñia'; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon jix duñia' cham gu suudai' mi'x dhaas tu' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ux gu xibh gu Faraoon gu suudai' gu chuukug gu suudai'; gio ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jugii'ñ gɨ' suudai' jiim vupui bhaan jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ gu ux jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu takarui'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ebreos tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' bham; mi' dhɨr mi'x dhaas tu' gu ja'tkam na ba' gu suudai' oidha' jix gaki; jano' ba' gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm jano' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' dhi' gu takarui' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu ux no'ñ gu novɨ gu suudai' gɨ' suudai' jiim gu oi'ñga'n gu ɨ'ɨr.
Jano' ba' gu vatop cham tu'x jai'ch gɨ' suudai' jiim koi gu oi'ñga'n gɨ' suudai' jiim jix duñia' gu vaak gu Egipkios i'i gu suudai' gɨ' suudai' jiim.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' tu' gu Aaroon; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gu ux muuk gu novɨ bhaan gu suudai' gu Ejipto bhaan gu jodai' bhaan gu takarui' bhaan dhi' bhaan bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' na ba' jix duñia' gu ɨ'ɨr ka't gu ɨ'ɨr gu ux bɨx jix suudai' duu gu Ejipto gu jodai' gu u'u na ja'p gu jodai.

Jano' ba' gu Moisees gu Aaroon jix duu na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ux naaka'n gu suudai' ka't gɨ' suudai' jiim gu oi'ñga'n gu Faraoon tu duukam; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu suudai' ka't gɨ' suudai' jiim jix duñia' gu ɨ'ɨr.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu vatop ka't gɨ' suudai' jiim jix koko'; gio ba' gɨ' suudai' jiim jix duñia' gu Egipkios cham gu ñi'ook i'i; mi' dhɨr ka't gu ɨ'ɨr gu ux bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto jix duu bɨɨx gu vaak; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon jix duñia' cham jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Faraoon jix duñia' gu vaak cham jix dhaas gu i'ii'ñ gu suudai' dhi'.
Na gu' bɨx gu Ejipto jix duu oidha' suudai' xikoolh gɨ' suudai' jiim na ba' i'i na gu' cham gu ñi'ook i'i gu suudai' gɨ' suudai' jiim.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' kɨɨv gu tanoolh mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios naaka'n gɨ' suudai' jiim.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' ba'k gu Faraoon gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' mi'x dhaas tu' gu ja'tkam na ba' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mi'x dhaas tu' gu suudai' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gɨ' suudai' jiim jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n jix tɨ'ɨ jɨjɨkgɨm gu vaak gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu takarui' bhaan gu takarui' gu vaak tu duukam gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan tu' bhaan gu ja'tkam bhaan bɨx tu duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' tu' gu Aaroon; mi' dhɨr muuk gu novɨ bɨɨx gu ux bhaan gu jodai' gu takarui' dhi' na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu kutun gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Aaroon jix duñia' gu novɨ bhaan gu suudai' gu Ejipto jix tɨ'ɨ gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duu bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu kutun gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu oidha' gu Ejipto.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Faraoon jup tɨɨt gu Moisees gu Aaroon; gio ba' gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr mi'x dhaas tu' gu ja'tkam na ba' gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Faraoon; gio ba' tu' gu takarui' bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr duuk gu ñi'ook gu ux tu' gu ux tu duukam gu ux gu ja'tkam na ba' gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu ñi'ook tu' gu vaak gu suudai' gu jodai' gɨ' suudai' jiim.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu xibh; mi' dhɨr gu Moisees jix aa'; jano' ba' jix duñia' jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu chuukug cham cham tu'x jai'ch na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook tu' gu vaak tu duukam gu ja'tkam gu suudai' jix duñia' gɨ' suudai' jiim.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' moor gu Moisees gu Aaroon bɨɨx gu Faraoon tu ñi'ook gu Moisees gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu ñi'ook gu Faraoon.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Moisees jix koko' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak gu suudai' vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gɨ' kavɨk jix duñia' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Faraoon a'ga jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ cham jix duñia'; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' tu' gu Aaroon; mi' dhɨr muuk gu ux gu takarui' oo' gu oidha' na ba' jix duñia' gu jodai' gu ux bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duu; gio ba' gu Aaroon jix duñia' gu novɨ bɨɨx gu ux naaka'n oo' gu oidha' jix duñia' gu jodai' gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu vaakax; mi' dhɨr bɨx oo' gu oidha' jix duñia' gu jodai' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duu gio na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt; gu' cham jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr ka't gu jodai' gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' nɨi'ñdha' gui'p gu Faraoon; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios dhi'; gu' gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon jix duñia' cham jix duñia'; jano' ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu Lebaantate gu xibh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan gu Faraoon gu suudai' gu chuukug gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr gu takarui'; jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' mi'x dhaas tu' gu ja'tkam na ba' gu takarui'.

Na gu' na gu' tu' cham mi'x dhaas tu' gu ja'tkam gu suudai' tu' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan tu' bhaan tu duukam bhaan gu ja'tkam bhaan gu vaak bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai'; gio ba' gu vaak gu Egipkios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' gu suudai' gu oidha' pai'.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu' gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' gu Goseen gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n na ba' matgɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' ka't; na ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu kutun tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu xibh ka't dhi' nɨi'ñchudat.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios; na suudai' u'va bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' gu takarui' bhaan gu vaak gu Faraoon bhaan gu vaak tu duukam bhaan bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu Ejipto; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' ka't gu ñi'ook kuiñcha.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Faraoon jup tɨɨt gu Moisees gu Aaroon; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa'; na gu' cham jix duñia' jix duu na gu' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Egipkios; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' tu' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Egipkios vupui bhaan cham gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt vaik gu tanoolh gu takarui' gu ux oidha' jix gaki maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' gu Faraoon; gio ba' tu' mi'x dhaas tu' na ba' gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios oidha' jix gaki bɨɨx jix duñia' cham gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' gu ux tu'.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' gu suudai' gamai' tu' bɨndak gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios ɇɇka' mamai'chɨk gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt gu Faraoon tu duukam gu ja'tkam gu xibh; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx jix duñia' gu Faraoon cham jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n cham mi'x dhaas tu' gu ja'tkam maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Moisees jix buus bɨɨx gu Faraoon jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Moisees; gio ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt mii' dhɨr gu jodai' gu Faraoon tu duukam gu ja'tkam cham gu suudai'.
Gu' gu' gu Faraoon jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt dhi' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ cham mi'x dhaas tu' gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' ba'k gu Faraoon gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu ebreos tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' mi'x dhaas tu' gu ja'tkam na ba' gu suudai'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mi'x dhaas tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan gu vaakax yooxi' kavaayo gu ñi'ook jix ai gu jodai' kakneer bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu suudai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu Israeel gu Ejipto cham tu' gu jodai' bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios nɨi'ñchudat gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu xibh jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tanoolh buimgidhak gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr jix koi bɨx gu vaakax gu Ejipto; gu' gu vaakax gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham jix koi maa'n.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Faraoon bhañ gu suudai' gu vaakax gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham ka't jix koi maa'n; gu' gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon jix duñia' cham mi'x dhaas tu' gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ maatai gu duukam gu oi'ñga'n gu Moisees bhaan gu tɨkɨr vupui bhaan gu Faraoon.
Jano' ba' ɨlhdham gu suudai' oo' bhaan bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto jix duñia' gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ gu vaakax gu ux bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ maatai gu duukam jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu Faraoon tu jiim gu Moisees bhaan gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu jodai' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu vaakax.
Na gu' nɨi'ñdha' cham gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Moisees kuiñcha gu bhóogɨt na gu' ka't gu jodai' nɨi'ñdha' bɨx gu Egipkios.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon cham jix kai; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Moisees.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu Lebaantate gu xibh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan gu Faraoon gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu ebreos tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' mi'x dhaas tu' gu ja'tkam na ba' gu takarui'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu oi'ñga'n dhi' jix duñia' bɨx gu chuukug gu i'ii'ñ bhaan tu duukam bhaan gu ja'tkam na ba' gu bhóogɨt cham cham tu'x jai'ch na ja'p tu' bɨx gu oidha'.
Na gu' na gu' jano' tu' gu suudai' gu novɨ na ba' gu suudai' tu' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook ka' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tu'r tu' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu suudai' tu' bɨxchu'x gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't jix duñia' bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt tu' gu takarui' tu' bhaan gu ja'tkam na ba' cham mi'x dhaas tu'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu xibh dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a cham pai' dhuuk ka't gu Ejipto dɨr gu tanoolh jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm jano'.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' jix duu gu vaakax bɨx gu ñi'ook yooxi'; na gu' bɨx gu chio'ñ gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook yooxi' cham ka't gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu ñi'ook jix dhaav bhaan koi.
Jano' ba' jix duu tu duukam gu Faraoon jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' gu suudai' gu vaakax gu vaak.
Gu' gu' cham jix dhaas gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu suudai' yooxi'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' muuk gu novɨ bhaan gu tɨkɨr na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto bhaan gu chichio'ñ bhaan gu vaakax bhaan bɨx gu vaas yooxi' gu oi'ñga'n gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees jix duñia' gu ux bhaan gu tɨkɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ gu tai gu takarui' gu ux gu oidha'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bhaan gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu tai jɨ'kchi bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' cham pai' dhuuk ka't bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto dɨr ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook naaka'n bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto bɨx ka't yooxi' gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu vaakax; gio ba' gu suudai' naaka'n gu ñi'ook bɨx gu vaas yooxi' jix duñia' bɨx gu u'u gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu oidha' gu Goseen pai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mi'p cham ka't gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Faraoon bhañ tɨɨt gu Moisees gu Aaroon; gio ba' uañi'ñ dhi' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jir bhai' tu' gu ja'tkam jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' mi'x dhaas tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' gamai' tu' kiicham gu suudai' gu noobh gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook cham gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook; na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha'.
Gu' gu' tu' tu duukam gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu duukam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bɨɨx duu gu chuukug; na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu duukam gu oi'ñga'n.
Gu' gu' tiriik gu chuukug cham jix bɨɨx duu gu chuukug; na gu' jix duñia' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Moisees bɨɨx gu Faraoon kiicham jix duñia' gu noobh gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' dhuuk cham jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Faraoon dhuuk ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ tu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon jix duñia' cham mi'x dhaas tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Moisees.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' ba'k gu Faraoon; na gu' tu' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ tu duukam na ba' gu chuukug tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' buimɨk.
Jano' ba' na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook tu'x tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu Ejipto buimɨk tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' na ba' gu bhóogɨt tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu Faraoon gui'p; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ebreos tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx ka'm duuk cham gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan tu' mi'x dhaas tu' gu ja'tkam na ba' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt mi'x dhaas tu' gu suudai' tu' gu jodai' gu xibh gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu oidha' cham gu bhóogɨt tɨɨ'ñ gu oidha'; gio ba' jugi gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jugi gu suudai' bɨx gu u'u gu vaak gu i'bhɨ yooxi'.

Jano' ba' jix bhuup gu vaak bɨx tu duukam gu vaak bɨx gu Egipkios cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' tattat tu' gu takarui' dɨr jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' jix buus bɨɨx gu Faraoon.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu duukam gu Faraoon gui'p; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk tu' gu suudai' gu ux gu vaak mi'x dhaas tu' dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ na ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' cham ñɨidhat gu Ejipto gu jodai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Aaroon suulh gu suudai' mɨmɨim gu Faraoon; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr chɨkka jix duñia' tu'.

Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa'; gio ba' gu jodai' tu' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook a'aalh bɨɨx gu ñi'ook kɨklhi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx gu ñi'ook kakneer bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu jodai' tu'; na gu' tañia' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ñi'ook na ja'p tu' mi'x dhaas tu' gu ñi'ook a'aalh; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' na ja'p cham bhai' vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' cham ka't; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt jano' gu takarui' gu chichio'ñ gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' dhi' gu takarui' jix duñia'; jano' ba' mi'x juu'ñ vupui bhaan gu Faraoon.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' muuk gu novɨ bhaan gu oidha' gu Ejipto na ba' gu ñi'ook jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan gu oi'ñga'n gu Ejipto jix duñia' bɨx gu ñi'ook mi'x dhaas.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Moisees gu ux bhaan gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu Jawatan Dios jix bhɨɨ gu jɨvɨl gu ux na tu ibai' bhaan gu oi'ñga'n bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'; gio ba' gu xibh gu jɨvɨl gu ux na tu ibai' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto jix duñia' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; gio ba' va'k cham ka't gu ñi'ook nɨidhim tu' mi' dhɨr ɨlhdham jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan dhaas gu vupui bɨx gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu oidha'; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨx gu vaas gu oidha' bɨx gu i'bhɨ gu u'u ka't tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu ñi'ook; na cham gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaas gu u'u tu' gu vaas yooxi' gu ux bɨx pai' gu Ejipto.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Faraoon jix duu tɨɨt jix duñia' gu Moisees gu Aaroon; gio ba' uañi'ñ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' soi'ñ jano' gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ gu suudai' dhi' jix duñia' gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tu' gu suudai' dhi' koi'm.
Jano' ba' jix buus bɨɨx gu Faraoon jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu jɨvɨl gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon; gio ba' cham bhañ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' muuk gu novɨ bhaan gu tɨkɨr na ba' ka't gu tukgam bhaan gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu takarui' no'x gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Moisees gu novɨ bhaan gu tɨkɨr ka't gu jodai' gu tukgam vaik gu tanoolh gu ux bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix ñi' tɨtmo tu' soo'mchulhdhak jix búup pai' vaik gu tanoolh; gu' bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel ko'kmarak gu tasi' gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Faraoon jix duu tɨɨt gu Moisees; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu jodai' kakneer gu jodai'; jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gio a'aalh bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gio kapbhai' makgɨrxi'ñdha' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gio bɨɨx no'ch; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu jodai' jix bhɨɨ na ba' tu juan gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu jodai' tu juan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai'.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon cham gu oi'ñga'n mi'x dhaas tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Faraoon; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt tu'; na gu' gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu vupui na gu' gu chuukug gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu vupui koi.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa'; gio ba' xoi'kam tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham gu oi'ñga'n gu vupui.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Faraoon bhaan gu Ejipto; mi' dhɨr kiicha' tu'; jano' ba' jix bhai'x mi'x juu'ñ bɨx.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook jano' gu ja'tkam maa'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux jix toja jodai jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa nɨidhidha' gu ja'tkam gu vupui gu Egipkios; gio ba' gio gu Moisees ka't gu bhóogɨt gu chio'ñ gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu vupui tu duukam gu Faraoon gu vupui gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr ɨraab gu tukaa' tu' gu jodai' gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' koi bɨx maa'nkam mar gu oidha' gu Ejipto dɨr maa'nkam mar gu Faraoon gu chuukug atooxkor bɨɨx ka'm maa'nkam mar ja'tkam na tu juan bhaan gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' bɨx maa'nkam mar gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n tu ñi'ook gu ux bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto cham pai' dhuuk ka't tu' mɨɨjidha' ka't.
Gu' gu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel dɨr gu chio'ñ bɨɨx ka'm gu vaakax tu' gagai' gu jodai' nɨɨn; na ba' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Egipkios gu Israelitas.

Jano' ba' jix dhaav tu' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam tu duukam gu jodai' vupui bhaan tu' gu chuukug; gio ba' jix buus tu' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu suudai' tu'; mi' dhɨr dhi' tu' gu jodai'; jano' ba' jix buus gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x bɨɨx gu Faraoon.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu Faraoon cham gu bhóogɨt na ba' kɨɨ'p gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees gu Aaroon jix duu bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan gu Faraoon; gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu jodai' gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon cham bhañ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mai' gu oi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu oidha' gu Ejipto bham.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu takarui' ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam masaa'n; gio ba' ka't dhi' na ba' gu ñi'ook maa'n masaa'n oi'ñga'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel bham; gio ba' mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu chuukug maa'n mar kaneer gu ux gu jodai' tattat mar kaneer gu ux ja'tkam vaak.

Gu' gu' tu' ja'tkam vaak ka't gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n cham gu bhóogɨt jugi mar kaneer jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu chuukug gu jodai' gu vaak bhaan jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu bhóogɨt maa'n jurtu'nka' jugi mi'x juu'ñ jix duñia' bhaan mar kaneer.
Jano' ba' mar kaneer ka't cham gu jodai' gu chio'ñ oi'ñga'; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ kakneer gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' nukadham bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook dhi' gu takarui'; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu Israeel tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook xib ja'k tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ɨ'ɨr jix duñia' gook gu maa'nkar gu chuukug gu vaak jix duñia' jugi.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' jugi gu chuukug gu jodai' gu tai gu takarui' cham jabka'; gio ba' bɨɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jugi.
Jano' ba' matgɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jugi gu bhóogɨt tu' gu chuukug gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu tai; gio ba' mo'o bɨɨx tɨɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' matgɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mi'x dhaas bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tai.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jugi; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook tɨɨt gu suudai' gu novɨ; mi' dhɨr jugi jix bhai'x; jano' ba' gu Paskua gu Jawatan Dios.

Na gu' tu' gu suudai' mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' gu ux gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx maa'nkam mar gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu vaakax; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios gu Ejipto; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu ɨ'ɨr ka't gu ux nɨi'ñchudat gu vaak pai' gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu ɨ'ɨr gu suudai' gu ñi'ook cham gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu ux jix koi na pai' dhuuk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tanoolh tu' gu suudai' chɨ'ñchoka' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu ux ñi'ook kavɨk gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jugi gu takarui' cham jabka'; gio ba' maa'n gu tanoolh jix duu cham ka't jabka' gu vaak; na gu' no'x jugi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dɨr maa'n gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm kɨɨv mii' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu tanoolh gu oi'ñga'n abhaar gu ñi'ook gu suudai' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix duñia' abhaar gu ñi'ook; gio ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt ka't jugi.
Na gu' nukadham gu takarui' gu chuukug na gu' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ chugi'ñ gu oidha' gu Ejipto; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' nukadham dhi' gu tanoolh gu ma'nkam gu ux gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' maa'n gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu ux gu xumai jugi gu takarui' cham jabka' bɨɨx ka'm gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu ux gu xumai.
Na gu' gu ux kɨɨv gu tanoolh cham gu ñi'ook jabka' gu vaak na gu' no'x jugi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ja'tkam mii' dhɨr na ja'p gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n mii' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' matgɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jugi; gio ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook jugi gu takarui' cham jabka'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees jix duñia' bɨx daraa gu Israeel; gio ba' gu takarui' jix bhɨɨ ali' karneer gu ux ja'tkam vaak maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gakdhi'ñchix.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ɨ'ɨr gu jodai' gu ñi'ook maa'n gu chuukug gook gu maa'nkar bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr gu jodai' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' gu ñi'ook kiki'ñgob gu vaak bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh.

Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu Egipkios; gio ba' na ja'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr gu chuukug gook gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr ki'ñgob cham kiicha' baakɨi gu ux gu vaak na ba' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' nukadham dhi' gu ux ñi'ook kavɨk na ba' gu takarui' na ba' gu ma'nkam na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu novɨ kia'mi'ñ gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios maa'n na ja'p juraa'n tu ñi'ook nukadham dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi'.

Jano' ba' gu takarui' tu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug gu Paskua gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu vaak gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Ejipto na pai' dhuuk naaka'n gu Egipkios jix duñia' baak gu vaak; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu jix duu jix bhai'x; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees gu Aaroon.

Jano' ba' ka't ɨraab gu Jawatan Dios naaka'n bɨx maa'nkam mar gu oidha' gu Ejipto dɨr maa'nkam mar gu Faraoon jix duñia' bhaan atooxkor bɨɨx ka'm maa'nkam mar gu suudai' ka't kuupa' bɨx maa'nkam mar gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' jix búup mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' gu Faraoon bɨx tu duukam bɨx gu Egipkios; na gu' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Ejipto na gu' cham ka't gu vaak pai' cham gu takarui' jix koi.
Ba' jix aa' jix duu tɨɨt gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu tukaa'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu takarui' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p jix duñia' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio kakneer gu jodai' na ja'p jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu takarui'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gio tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Egipkios jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug mi'x juu'ñ gu oidha'; na gu' am:―Ja'pji; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu'ch koko'kam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ va'k jix duñia' gu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Moisees gu oi'ñga'n gu Egipkios gu ux jix toja jodai gu ux jix uam jodai jajannulhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa nɨidhidha' gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan gu Egipkios jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Egipkios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Rameses gu Sukkot na ja'p gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ tɨɨt cham gu chuukug a'aalh.
Jano' ba' gio jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu oi'ñga'n jix maat gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' kakneer gu vaakax gu bhóogɨt mui'x.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug cham jabka' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' jix buusñi gu Ejipto; na gu' cham ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na gu' mi'x juu'ñ gu Egipkios cham gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' tu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook jugi.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix daa gu Ejipto ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu tanoolh moor bɨx chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu tukaa' nukadham gu Jawatan Dios gu ux jix duñia' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto; gio ba' dhi' gu tukaa' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ nukadham gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ma'nkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon; gio ba' dhi' jir bɨx bhai' gu Paskua; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n gu tanoolh jugi.
Gu' gu' bɨx tu duukam gu ja'tkam jugi gu ux tuumiñ gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr jix bhai'x cham jugi.
Jano' ba' gu vaak jugi cham gu jodai' mii' dhɨr gu chuukug mai' gu vaak tu' jix duñia' o'o gu kutun.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan.

Gu' gu' tu' gu kutun ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n bɨndak gu bhóogɨt duñia' gakdhi'ñchix gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook bɨx gu chio'ñ jano' ba' jix duñia' duñia' ka't na ja'p gu chuukug gu oidha'; gu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ñi'ook na tu a'ga ka't na ba' gu chuukug na ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duu bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' na ja'p jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon jix duu.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix buusñi gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu ux gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' bɨx maa'nkam mar no'x gu jodai' gu takarui' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu vaakax; gio ba' gu chuukug.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ja'tkam chɨ'ñchoka' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto gu vaak juantu'n; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix buusñi bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' cham jugi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gɨgɨ'lhi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu Abib.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't gu jodai' gu oidha' gu Kananeo gu takarui' gu Amorreo gu suudai' gu Jebuseo gu ñi'ook tattat tu' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu oi'ñga'n bii'm gu ñi'ook jix duu dhi' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jugi gu ux gu jodai' kɨɨv gu tanoolh ka't gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ux kɨɨv gu tanoolh jugi gu takarui' cham jabka'; gio ba' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨndak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' jabka' bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu mar bham; na pai' dhuuk duñia' dhi' bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gu chuukug na pai' dhuuk jix buusñi gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' tu' ka't na ja'p nɨi'ñchudat bhaan gu novɨ na ja'p chɨ'ñchoka' vupui bhaan gu vupui na ba' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios gu chin; na gu' bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk tu' jix buusñi gu Jawatan Dios gu Ejipto.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' tu' nukadham dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook oidha' tas.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't gu jodai' gu oidha' gu Kananeo na ja'p tu' gu ñi'ook tu' tattat na pai' dhuuk tu' ka't jix maa.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' gu suudai' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' gu vaakax; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' bɨx maa'nkam mar gu ñi'ook bɨɨx mar kaneer; gio ba' tu' cham tu jiim gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ja'tkam maa'nkam mar gu ma'nkam.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu xibh tu' tu ñi'ook gu mar bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' daipu'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix buusñi bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk gu Ejipto gu vaak juantu'n.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Faraoon cham mi'x dhaas tu' gu Jawatan Dios mu'aa gu oidha' gu Ejipto bɨx maa'nkam mar dɨr maa'nkam mar gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka'm maa'nkam mar gu vaakax; gio ba' gu ux dhi' kuiñcha tu' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios bɨx maa'nkam mar gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨx maa'nkam mar gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' tu' ka't na ja'p nɨi'ñchudat bhaan gu novɨ gu ux chɨ'ñchoka' vupui bhaan gu vupui; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix buusñi gu Ejipto bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk.

Jano' ba' gu Faraoon mi'x dhaas tu' gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios cham jix duñia' gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' gu Pilisteos ka't mia'n; na gu' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; na pai' dhuuk gu kutun cham gu suudai' gu ja'tkam na pai' dhuuk gu jodai' bhɨɨ'ñdham gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu ux gu bhóogɨt oidha' jix gaki gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Ejipto gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio baidhak gu Moisees o'oo gu Josee ka't gu jodai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix duu jix tɨ'ɨ o'oo bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Sukkot jix duñia' yooxi' gu Etam ba'k oidha' jix gaki.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug vupui bhaan gu tanoolh gu vaak toov na ba' jix duñia' gu ux gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu tukaa' gu vaak gu tai na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu tanoolh gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk ta'tak vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam gu vaak toov gu tanoolh tu' gu tukaa' gu vaak gu tai.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix maa gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt yooxi' vupui bhaan gu Piairot tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Migdol gu gɨ' suudai' bhaan gu Baalsepoon; gio ba' vupui bhaan jix duñia' yooxi' ju'ñdharan gu gɨ' suudai'.
Na gu' na gu' gu Faraoon gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu chuukug gu oidha' oidha' jix gaki tu' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon na ba' gu chuukug; gio ba' jix duñia' tas na jix gɨ' gu Faraoon bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' gu Egipkios tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix duu.

Jano' ba' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon tu duukam jix duñia' bhaan gu ja'tkam gui'p; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu suudai' tɨtda:―Cha'pim tu' gu Israeel na ba' cham gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' tu jiim gu duukam jix bhɨɨ baidhak gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto gu ñi'ook bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto chɨ'ɨɨk gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu suudai' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu novɨ gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Egipkios bɨɨx bɨx kavaayo gu ñi'ook gu Faraoon gu ja'tkam kavaayo bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jix duñia' gu suudai' yooxi' ju'ñdharan gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Piairot vupui bhaan gu Baalsepoon.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Faraoon ka't gu jodai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' gu vupui gu suudai' gu Egipkios aajidha' bhaan; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu Moisees; gio ba' cham ka't pai'm gu Ejipto jix buusñi na ba' vaak jodai oidha' jix gaki gu ux gu ñi'ook bɨɨx no'ch jix buusñi gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' cham dhi' tu' a'aixkam gu Ejipto bham; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n tu juan gu Egipkios tutkɨ mai' tu juan gu Egipkios koi no'ch oidha' jix gaki.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' tulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu Egipkios gu ñi'ook jix duñia' buupui cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n na ba' bɨɨx tas gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu ñi'ook no'm gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux muuk gu novɨ bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' gu chuukug; gio ba' kapbhai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' tu' gu suudai' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ gu Egipkios na ba' gu jodai'; gio ba' tu' tas na jix gɨ' gu Faraoon bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ñi'ook kavaayo.
Na pai' dhuuk gu jodai' gu Egipkios tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk tas na jix gɨ' gu Faraoon gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam kavaayo.

Jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug vupui bhaan yooxi' gu Israeel jix ai'chdhix gu chuukug gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu suudai' gu vaak toov gu chuukug vupui bhaan jix ai'chdhix jix dhaas gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug tɨjɨɨ'ñ yooxi' gu Egipkios yooxi' gu Israeel; gio ba' ka't toov gu tukgam na ba' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu Israeel gu tukaa'; mi' dhɨr bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jix duu jix duñia' gu Moisees gu novɨ bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ' suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu i'ii'ñ gu jɨvɨl gu ux na tu ibai' bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ' suudai' jix gaki gu suudai' jix duñia' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel baap gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' jix gaki da'p gu suudai' na ja'p gu ñi'ook kɨɨ'n gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu Egipkios baap bhaan bɨɨx ka'm tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' bɨx kavaayo gu Faraoon gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam kavaayo.
Jano' ba' ka't jix duñia' gu xibh gu Jawatan Dios tu jiim yooxi' gu Egipkios dɨr gu vaak gu tai toov jix duñia' yooxi' gu Egipkios.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt ia'lhxichulh gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; gio ba' jano' ba' gu Egipkios gui'p; na gu' gu chuukug vupui bhaan gu Israeel na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt gu ux bhaan gu Egipkios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' muuk gu novɨ bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' na ba' gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x bhaan gu Egipkios bhaan gu ñi'ook bhaan kavaayo.

Na pai' dhuuk gu Moisees jix duñia' gu novɨ bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' jix duñia' gu kavɨk na pai' dhuuk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu Egipkios jix duñia' bhaan; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Egipkios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' suulh gu suudai' gu ñi'ook kavaayo bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Faraoon ka't kia'mi'ñ bhaan gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook tu' maa'n.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' jix gaki da'p gu suudai' gu ux gu ñi'ook kɨɨ'n gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Israeel gu novɨ gu Egipkios; gio ba' gu Israeel jix ñi' gu Egipkios koko'kam jugii'ñ gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Israeel mii' dhɨr jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' bhaan gu Egipkios; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees tu duukam.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jiiñ gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel dhi' gu duukam gu Jawatan Dios gui'p; na gu' jix duñia' tu' gu Jawatan Dios na gu' tu' gu jodai' jix bhai'x mi'x juu'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' kavaayo jix tɨ'ɨ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' jix duñia' gu ux tulhiiñdha'; gio ba' gu ux gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu taat gu ux gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Faraoon ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham mi'x juu'ñ gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ chiñia' jix bɨɨx duu gu chuukug gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gɇ' suudai' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' na ja'p gu jodai jix dhaav gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' kɨɨ'n gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu kavɨk; gio ba' kɨɨ'n gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix bhai'x bhaamki'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu duukam gu suudai' bhaan jix búup bhaan tu'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt i'iich; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' na ja'p jajar.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu jodai' gu takarui' jix duñia' gu suudai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ja'p gɨ' kavɨk; mi' dhɨr gɇ' suudai' gu duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' bhaamki'ñdha'; gio ba' gu jodai' gu chuukug gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' jix buusñi gu kuchii gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' jix jɨvɨl bɨɨx gu jɨvɨl gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' jix duñia' na ja'p gu ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' chɨkka na ja'p tu' gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios chɨkka na ja'p tu' gu chuukug jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu ja'tkam kɨɨ'p.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' kɨɨ'n; gio ba' gu oidha' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch dhi' gu ja'tkam dodhia'; gio ba' gu suudai' bɨɨx gu maa'nkar ba'bhak xidhuu.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt jix koi gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' chiñia' gu Edom jix duñia'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Moab jix duñia' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bɨx jix koi gu Kanaan.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' bhaan gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu duukam gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na ja'p gu jodai; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ux na tu ibai' gu kavɨk gu maa'nkar pai' jix koi tu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' xidhuu gu Jawatan jix duñia' gu suudai' gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu ux gu suudai'.

Na gu' na gu' gu Faraoon chɨbiapui gu jodai' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam kavaayo gu gɨ' suudai' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu gɨ' suudai' bhaan; gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu jix gaki gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu Mariia gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu ja'tkam gu Aaroon jix bhɨɨ gu vaak gu novɨ bɨx gu u'vɨ moor gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu vaak gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Mariia tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tɨ'ya' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu suudai' mi'x juu'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' kavaayo jix tɨ'ɨ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees gu takarui' gu Israeel gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook moor oidha' jix gaki gu Sur; gio ba' jix duñia' vaik gu tanoolh gu ux oidha' jix gaki cham gu ñi'ook gu suudai'.
Na gu' jix duñia' gu Mara cham jix duñia' i'i gu suudai' gu Mara na gu' jix duñia' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Mara.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam vaak jodai bhaan gu Moisees; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' i'i.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu u'u gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr jix maa ñi'ook kavɨk gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu vupui gu chuukug naak gu ñi'ook nukadham bɨx ñi'ook kavɨk matgɨm ko'kdai' jix duñia' gu Egipkios tu' gu oi'ñga'n tu'; na gu' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Elim pai' ka't gu kutun suudai' buusñi gu suudai' gu vaak gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x; gio ba' jix duñia' ju'ñdharan gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Elim bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel suudai' u'va oidha' jix gaki cham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Elim gu Sinaii gu bhóogɨt gu tanoolh gook gu takarui' mi' dhɨr moor gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vaak jodai bhaan gu Moisees gu Aaroon oidha' jix gaki.

Jano' ba' am:―Ja'pji gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu chuukug jix koi gu ux gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' gu Ejipto na pai' dhuuk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu chuukug na pai' dhuuk jugi gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt; na gu' jix duñia' jix buusñi dhi' oidha' jix gaki na ba' kooda' bhiogi' bɨx dhi' gu oi'ñga'n.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu Miren tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu tɨkɨr; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam gu jodai' jix duñia' na ba' gu tanoolh na ba' tu' gu suudai' tu' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga cham.
Gu' gu' xijumai gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt ka't jix bhai'x gu tas jix duñia' gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees gu Aaroon bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu xumai gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu xibh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' naak gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; na no'ch gu ñi'ook gu'ch na ba' gu takarui' vaak jodai bhaan no'ch.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios maa'n gu xumai gu chuukug na ba' jugi gu xibh gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' naak gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx jix duñia' vaak jodai bhaan; na no'ch gu ñi'ook gu'ch gu bhóogɨt cham bhaan no'ch gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Aaroon; gio ba' tu' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios; na tu' naak gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' a'gi'ñchu' gu Aaroon bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' bhaan oidha' jix gaki gu suudai' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi'ñ toov.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' tu' naak gu bhóogɨt gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu suudai' bham; mi' dhɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook xib ja'k tɨkɨr jugi gu chuukug gu ux gu xibh jix duñia' gu takarui' gu jodai' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' namkia' gu xumai jix tɨ'ɨ novɨ maa'nkar gu ñi'ook vaak ja'tkam; gio ba' gu xibh jix dhaav gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu suudai' jix utu'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' bhaan gu vupui oidha' jix gaki gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' gu takarui' gu jodai' na ja'p gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gui'p; na gu' gu bhóogɨt dhi' na gu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt ka't; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa'; jano' ba' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa na ba' jugi.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix aa'ñdhix; gio ba' jix duñia' maa'n bhaan gu bhóogɨt jugi; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu ux mo'o jurtu'nka' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu bhóogɨt jix bhɨɨ maa'n na ba' vaak zel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duu; gio ba' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ux gu suudai' cham jix duñia' ka't gu ñi'ook jix jai' tu' jix duñia' ka't gu ñi'ook gu jodai'; gio ba' maa'n jix duñia' jurtu'nka' ka't jugi.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mi'x dhaas cham tu' gu i'ii'ñ na ba' gu xibh.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu' cham jix duñia' gu Moisees gu ñi'ook dhɨt mi'x dhaas gu i'ii'ñ na ba' gu tanoolh gu tasi' jix duñia'; gio ba' bhaam bhaan gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu xibh maa'n bhaan ka't jugi; gio ba' gu tas jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' xijumai gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt jugi gook gu ñi'ook na ba' maa'n; gio ba' bɨx chiñia' gu ñi'ook tɨɨtɨs gu Moisees jix duu maachim.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' dhi' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu xibh jix bhaan juanda' jɨɨpi'ñka' gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' bɨx bhaan nukadham na ba' gu xibh.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' nukadham bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh bhaan gu Moisees ka't jix aa'ñdhix cham jix duñia' tu' ka't nu'aidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; na gu' jugi gu ñi'ook na gu' gu ñi'ook juanda' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu tanoolh jix duñia'; gu' kɨɨv gu tanoolh juanda' cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't dhɨt gu ja'tkam moor kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix duu cham gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk cham gu oi'ñga'n nukadham gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa juanda' gu ux gu ñi'ook jix maa xijumai gu tanoolh gu takarui' na ba' gook gu tanoolh; gio ba' maa'n dhi' soo'mchulhdhak gu ñi'ook pai' kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix utu'ñ kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu vaak gu Israeel jup tɨɨt gu takarui'; gio ba' ka't na ja'p gu kai' gu ñi'ook jix toja gu ja'tkam na ja'p gu suudai' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' dhi' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix aa'ñdhix; na pai' dhuuk gu takarui' gu suudai' na ba' nukadham na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu takarui' tu' jugi oidha' jix gaki na pai' dhuuk tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Aaroon; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ vaaso gu takarui' gu suudai' jix bhuup gu takarui' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' ka't nukadham na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Aaroon jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu Testimonio na ba' nukadham na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' koi'mɨk gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu takarui' oo'm gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm baap gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu takarui' koi'mɨk bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' gu oidha' pai' gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu Epa.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel ta'tak oidha' jix gaki cham gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' yooxi' gu Repidim; gio ba' cham ka't gu suudai' na ba' gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu Moisees gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr gu Moisees jix aa'; jano' ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu chuukug gu ux gu ñi'ook vaak zel gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' vaak jodai bhaan gu Moisees; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n jix tɨ'ɨ gu Ejipto na ba' kooda' gu ñi'ook no'ch gu oi'ñga'n gu ma'nkam gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Moisees gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx dhi' gu ja'tkam gu vaak jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam jix bhɨɨ bɨndak daraa gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gio gu novɨ gu ux bɨɨx gu chuukug gɨ' suudai' jiim tu'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' dhi' vupui bhaan tu' bhaan jodai kavɨk gu oreb; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jodai kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu suudai' i'i gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Moisees jix duu gu oi'ñga'n daraa gu Israeel.
Na gu' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu Massa gu Meriba gu ux gu takarui' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na gu' vaak zel gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch cham.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Amalek gu ux bɨɨx gu Israeel gu Repidim.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Josuee; gio ba' gu suudai' gu chichio'ñ jix buus gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu Amalek; mi' dhɨr gu xibh tu' dhi' bhaan gu ux gu ja'tkam gu ux gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ.
Ba' jix aa' jix duu gu Josuee na ja'p gu Moisees gu ux bɨɨx gu Amalek; gio ba' gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu ur jix tɨ'ɨ gu ux gu ja'tkam.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tanoolh na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu Moisees gu novɨ gu Israeel gu suudai'; na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu novɨ gu suudai' gu Amalek.

Jano' ba' gu noobh gu Moisees mi'p gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ux jix bhɨɨ gu jodai jix dhaas bɨtaa'n jix daa bhaan; mi' dhɨr gu Aaroon gu ur jix duñia' gu noobh maa'n baasɨ'n; jano' ba' ka't gu noobh gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm jix dhaas gu tas.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Josuee gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Amalek gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt gu kuchii.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' ua'ñxidha' dhi' na ba' chɨ'ñchoka' u'uan tu' gu Josuee bɨx no'ñ gu suudai' chɨ'ñchoka' gu Amalek bɨtaa'n gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa'; na gu' gu novɨ bhaan atooxkor gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx gu Amalek gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix kai gu Jetro jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Madiaan jir bɨx bhai' gu Moisees bɨx tu'x gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Moisees bɨɨx gu Israeel gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix buusñi gu Israeel gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Jetro jir bɨx bhai' gu Moisees gu oi'ñga'n gu u'vɨ gu Moisees mi' dhɨr bhañ.
Jano' ba' gook gu ma'nkam; na gu' maa'n jup tɨɨt gu Gersom na gu' jix aa' jix duñia' gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' jup tɨɨt gu Elieser na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu taat gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Faraoon.
Jano' ba' gu Jetro jir bɨx bhai' gu Moisees bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu u'vɨ jix duñia' gu Moisees oidha' jix gaki pai' ga'ra' yooxi' ju'ñdharan gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' tu' jir bɨx bhai' gu Jetro gu bhóogɨt tu' bɨɨx gu u'vɨ gook gu ma'nkam bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix buus gu takarui' jir bɨx bhai' jix duñia' gu chuukug; gio ba' tɨkka maa'n gu ñi'ook mi'p tɨɨtɨs vaak zel.

Jano' ba' gu Moisees gu ñi'ook jir bɨx bhai' bɨx tu'x gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook gu Faraoon gu Egipkios gu ux xoi'kam gu Israeel bɨx tu jiim gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook ka't gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jetro bɨx xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook gu Israeel ka't gu takarui' gu novɨ gu Egipkios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jetro; gio ba' gu takarui' ka't gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu novɨ gu Egipkios gu novɨ gu Faraoon jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu novɨ gu Egipkios.
Jano' ba' jano' kakasnira' gu Jawatan Dios jix gɨ' gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' bhaan.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Jetro jir bɨx bhai' gu Moisees maa'nkar tai bhaan makgɨrxi'ñdha' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu Aaroon bɨx daraa gu Israeel jugi gu takarui' bɨɨx jir bɨx bhai' gu Moisees vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh jix daa gu Moisees gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ja'tkam juruuñ vupui bhaan gu Moisees dɨr gu xibh bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.

Ba' jix aa' ñɨi'ñ jir bɨx bhai' gu Moisees bɨx jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' duñia' tu' bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook tu' gu suudai' tu' gu duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan tu' dɨr gu xibh bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa' jir bɨx bhai'; na gu' gu ja'tkam jupaabkamu'n tu' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk namki' gu takarui' jupaabkamu'n tu'; gio ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ maa'n gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jir bɨx bhai' gu Moisees; gio ba' cham bhaan xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx tu' gio dhi' gu ja'tkam bɨndak; na gu' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook na ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr cham gu kutun duñia' tu' gu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' jano' gu ñi'ook tu' gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨndak; gio ba' tu' gu ux gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' tu' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu ux pai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu chichio'ñ tu'r gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu ñi'ook suulhgia' bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan jix bhai'x bhaan chamaam bhaan mambhɨɨx bhaan mambhɨɨx.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't bɨx gu chuukug gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu bhóogɨt tu' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu chuukug jix ali'; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' jix duñia' bɨndak.
Jano' ba' tu' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix aa'ñdhix tu' gu kutun gu jodai' bɨx dhi' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gio bhai'x i'ii'ñ pai'.
Ba' jix aa' jix kai gu Moisees gu ñi'ook jir bɨx bhai' jix duu bɨx.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Moisees gu chichio'ñ gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu Israeel jix dhaas gu ux ɨɨbhidham bhaan gu ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan jix bhai'x bhaan chamaam bhaan mambhɨɨx bhaan mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu chuukug gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu Moisees gu ñi'ook bɨx gu chuukug jix ali'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Moisees jir bɨx bhai' ka't gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' vaik gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oidha' gu Ejipto mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tɨɨtɨs oidha' jix gaki gu Sinaii.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Repidim jix duñia' oidha' jix gaki gu Sinaii jix duñia' oidha' jix gaki; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Israeel vupui bhaan gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jup tɨɨt dɨr gu kavɨk bham; mi' dhɨr daipu' gu vaak gu Jakob gu takarui' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu Egipkios gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ bhaan gu oi'ñga'n gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu jodai' tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' tu' jix maa naak gu ñi'ook nukadham ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu takarui' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ chumñigam bhaan bɨx gu ja'tkam; na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' ka't oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ja'tkam abhaar; gio ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook daipu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Moisees jup tɨɨt daraa gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam jix aa' gui'p; gio ba' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook chulhiiñchuda'; mi' dhɨr gu Moisees jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu bhóogɨt tu' toov gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt tu' chɨɨdaim bɨndak gio na ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' bɨɨx tas; mi' dhɨr gu Moisees jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' tu' gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu xibh gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a jajannulhi'ñ.
Na gu' gu suudai' na ba' gu tanoolh vaik na gu' vaik gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaav gu vupui bɨx gu ja'tkam bhaan gu kavɨk gu Sinaii.
Jano' ba' nɨi'ñchudat gu oidha' gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt bham; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n cham jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk tu' gu chuukug gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr no'x gu suudai' gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook koi.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu' ka't gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' ka't gu vaakax ka't gu chio'ñ cham ii'mdagaram; mi' dhɨr dhaibu gu chuukug jix bhai'x gu chuukug jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix dhaav gu Moisees gu kavɨk gu ja'tkam jix bhaan duu gu ja'tkam; gio ba' jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu suudai' na ba' vaik gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr cham gu chuukug gu u'vɨ.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't vaik gu tanoolh na pai' dhuuk suudai' u'va gu xibh tɨɨtɨs gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tasi' gu oi'ñga'n toov bhaan gu kavɨk gu suudai' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt jix kavɨk; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix buusñi vaak ja'tkam gu ja'tkam gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix dhaas gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk.
Na gu' bɨx gu kavɨk gu Sinaii gu ñi'ook na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' bhaan gu tai; gio ba' kuubh jix tɨ'ɨ na ja'p kuubh gu duukam bɨx gu kavɨk jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Moisees ua'rgidhimɨk gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix dhaav gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu kavɨk gu Sinaii bhaan gu ux gu kavɨk; gio ba' jup tɨɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu ux gu kavɨk gu Moisees jix tɨ'ɨ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; na gu' gu chuukug gu jodai' gu ja'tkam cham bhaan gu oidha' gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios na gu' gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n.
Na gu' gio jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt na gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu ja'tkam cham gu kutun jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk gu Sinaii na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook bham; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kavɨk gu oi'ñga'n.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu chuukug jix tɨ'ɨ tu' gu Aaroon bɨndak; na gu' gu' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ja'tkam cham bhaan gu oidha' gu ux jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jawatan Dios na gu' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees jix dhaav gu ja'tkam bɨɨx.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook bham.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu vaak tu duukam.
Jano' ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' cham tu' jix duu na jax chu'm tu' matgɨm na jax chu'm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jiix gu tɨkɨr tu' gu i'ii'ñ gu oidha' tu' gu suudai' bɨtaa'n gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' cham tu' gu chuukug tu' nɨidhat; na gu' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix kavɨk jix bhai'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' na cham jir bhai' tattat bhaan gu ma'nkam bhaan gu tanoolh bhaan jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n.
