Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' nukadham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham jix bhɨɨ gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'; na gu' cham maa'n gu ux gu tasi' gu Jawatan Dios jix bhɨɨ gu tɨɨgɨ' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh jɨɨpi'ñka' na ba' jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu tanoolh gu suudai' jix duu bɨx gu ñi'ook.

Gu' gu' kɨɨv gu tanoolh ka't jɨɨpi'ñka' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu mar tu' mar u'vɨ tu' tu duukam tu' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios tu' gu vaakax tu' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook kiki'ñgob.

Jano' ba' jix duu na gu' gu ux gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' gu gɨ' suudai' bɨx tu'x cham tu'x jai'ch jix utu'ñ kɨɨv gu tanoolh; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai' aa' gu tanoolh jɨɨpi'ñka' jix bhaan duu.
Jix bhaan ap tɨɨda' gu jum taat gio gu jum naan, na ap ba'x kɨɨ' oidha' bhaan gu oidha' na jum maa'n gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham koo'nda'.
Jano' ba' cham jugi jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' cham bɨɨna'.
Jano' ba' cham tu ñi'ook bhaan tɨtmo ɨɨxi'ñdha' chuut.
Jano' ba' cham gu jodai' gu vaak tɨtmo cham gu jodai' gu u'vɨ tɨtmo tu' tu duukam tu' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios tu' gu vaakax tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook tɨtmo.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam jix duñia' jiiñak jup tɨɨt gu suudai' gu chuukug gu kavɨk gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha'; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ja'tkam jix duñia' jix dhaas gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu Moisees; gio ba' tu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx no'ch gu chuukug; na gu' gu' cham tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx no'ch na gu' cham vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham gu takarui'; na gu' gu ux gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va gu Jawatan Dios na gu' choo'n gu oi'ñga'n na ba' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix dhaas gu suudai' gu Moisees jix duñia' ka't gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' daipu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix duñia' buupui tu ñi'ook dɨr gu tɨkɨr bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham xoi'kam gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios jix toja jodai tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix uam jodai jix duu.

Jano' ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu oidha' jix duu na ba' tu' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kakneer gu jodai'; gio ba' gu chuukug pai' tu' gu oi'ñga'n chɨ'ñchoka' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu suudai' tu' jix bhai' aa'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu jodai cham tu juan tɨ'ya'; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu tasi' bhaan tu' gu takarui'.
Na gu' cham jix tɨ'ɨ gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na gu' gu ñi'ook cham ka't ju'ñdharan gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu suudai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' jugi tu duukam gu ñi'ook gu ux gu takarui' tu juan; gu' kɨɨv gu jodai' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tu' chɨbiapui gu duukam gu jodai'; gio ba' tu' ga'ra' gu u'vɨ gu jodai' gu u'vɨ bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' tu' gu takarui' ka't jix maa gu u'vɨ ka't gu bhóogɨt gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam ka't gu takarui' gu jodai' gu duukam.
Jano' ba' tu' tu duukam gu takarui'; gio ba' tu' gu takarui' gu Jawatan gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam cham gu jodai' namkidhat.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu takarui' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu chuukug ki'ñgob gu maa'nkar; gio ba' gu takarui' jix duñia' naak bɨɨx gu suudai' ka't tu duukam na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mar u'vɨ gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios cham gu jodai' na ja'p gu chuukug jix buus tu duukam.
Na pai' dhuuk tu' cham gu chuukug gu Jawatan gu ux cham jix bhɨɨ gu ux tɨɨmo' gu oi'ñga'n gu kutun cham gu kutun gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu tanoolh na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n.
Gu' gu' tu' ka't jix duñia' bɨɨx gu mar jix duñia' bɨɨx bhaan gu takarui' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' tu' jix bhɨɨ cham gu oi'ñga'n jugi tu' tɨi'chu' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' tu' matgɨm dhi' vaik tu'x gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' nɨidhidha' cham tuumiñ.
Na gu chuukug oi'ñdha' gu jodai' koi.
Gu' gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix dhaas gu noobh jano' ba' tu' nɨi'ñchudat pai' tu' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' oi'ñdha' gu suudai' bhaan tɨtmo gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu suudai' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu jodai' na ba' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu taat gu naan koi.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu noobh koi.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu taat gu naan koi.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' dhɨt gu oi'ñga'n oi'ñdha' gu chuukug tɨtmo bɨɨx gu jodai bɨɨx gu ñi'ook cham gu jodai' gu' jix duñia' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook mai' bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jano' ba' ka't naaka'n gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' juruuñ gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' tu' oi'ñdha' gu chuukug tu duukam gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ ka't gu bhóogɨt.
Na gu' gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu tanoolh gook cham ka't gu bhóogɨt na gu' tuumiñ.
Jano' ba' tu' dhɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu u'vɨ gu ja'tkam gu chuukug gu takarui' gu' cham gu suudai' koi'm ka't gu bhóogɨt jurtu'nka' gu bhóogɨt gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt.
Gu' gu' tu' ka't koi'm jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' gu ux gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu vupui gu ux gu vupui taatam gu ux taatam gu novɨ gu ux gu novɨ tɨɨt gu ux tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' gu duukam gu ux gu duukam gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook koi'm gu ux koi'm.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' gu chuukug gu vupui tu duukam gu vupui gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu oi'ñga'n maa'n gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu vupui.
Jano' ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt taatam tu duukam taatam gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu ux taatam kiicha' tu' namkidhat.
Jano' ba' tu' gu vaakax gu takarui' gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' gu vaakax ka't gu takarui' cham jugi gu chuukug; gu' gu ñi'ook gu vaakax ka't gu bhóogɨt.
Gu' gu' tu' gu vaakax ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dɨr gu ñi'ook va'k gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook gu chuukug cham ka't nukadham gu bhóogɨt gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ gu vaakax ka't gu takarui' gio koi gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' ka't gu o'o gu bhóogɨt jano' ba' maa'n gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu jodai' ka't gu o'o.
Jano' ba' ka't gu chuukug gu mar ka't gu chuukug mar u'vɨ jurtu'nka' dhi' ñi'ook na jir bhai' jix duñia' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' tu' gu vaakax gu takarui' tu duukam gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt jix toja jodai gu Jawatan gu vaakax ka't gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' tu' oi'ñdha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ja'tkam cham gu takarui' jix duñia' gu vaakax gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam jix duñia' tuumiñ gu ñi'ook ka't jix koi ka't gu kutun.
Jano' ba' tu' gu vaakax oi'ñdha' gu chuukug gu vaakax tɨtmo gu ux gu jodai' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaakax gu ñi'ook tu jiim tuumiñ gio tu jiim jix koi.
Gu' gu' tu' ka't gu ja'tkam gu vaakax ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook va'k gu ñi'ook cham ka't nukadham jix duñia' gu vaakax gu i'ii'ñ gu vaakax jix koi ka't gu kutun.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' gu ñi'ook gu vaakax kaneer gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux mii' dhɨr gu vaakax jix duñia' jixchamaam gu vaakax gu ux mii' dhɨr kaneer maakobh kakneer.
Jano' ba' tu' ɨxkum ka't gaagam gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak ka't gu jodai' naaka'n cham ka't gu ñi'ook koi'm.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tas ka't bhaan gu ñi'ook ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui'; gio ba' ɨxkum gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x; mi' dhɨr tu' cham jix duñia' ka't jix duñia' gu ux.
Jano' ba' tu' ka't gaagam bɨɨx gu ux gu novɨ ka't gu vaakax buur kaneer ko'iix jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' tu' oi'ñdha' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug yooxi' oidha' u'va gu suudai' gu vaakax jugi gu oidha' tutkɨ pai' tutkɨ pai' u'va jix duñia'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu bhóogɨt gu tai gu ñi'ook jo'ii' ka't gu chuukug gɨ' kavɨk gu chuukug yooxi' gu tai jix duñia' gu chuukug.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' jix maa tɨtmo jix toja jodai gu ñi'ook nukadham ka't gu bhóogɨt gu vaak mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ tu' ɨxkum gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' tu' ɨxkum cham gu takarui' jano' ba' gɨ'kora' vaak gu vaak ka't gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu jodai' gu novɨ gu i'ii'ñ tɨtmo.

Na pai' dhuuk bhaan bɨx gu chuukug gu maa'nkar bhaan gu vaakax bhaan gu ñi'ook bhaan kaneer bhaan tɨi'chu' bhaan bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n na pai' dhuuk maa'n gu takarui'; gio ba' dhi' gu chuukug kuiñcha gu ñi'ook ɨlhdham vupui bhaan gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' jix duñia' jix bhai'x tɨtmo.
Jano' ba' tu' oi'ñdha' ka't jix maa tɨtmo buur gu vaakax kaneer gu chuukug gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n nukadham gu jodai' ka't baabuk cham jix ñi' soo'mchulhdhak.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n pai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook cham mi'x juu'ñ gu novɨ gu i'ii'ñ tɨtmo; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' cham jix duñia'.
Gu' gu' tu' ka't jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gɨ'kora' vaak.
Jano' ba' tu' ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook chuut cham jix duñia'.
Gu' gu' tu' oi'ñdha' ka't jix bhɨɨ gu chuukug gu vaakax tɨtmo ka't gu ñi'ook muukix gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gɨ'kora' vaak ka't gu o'o cham jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ɨlhdham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' oi'ñdha' iatgi'ñdha' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' cham ka't gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu suudai' gu jodai' jix bhɨɨ gu ux gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu taat cham gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' jix duñia' jix toja jodai jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug cham kiicha' gu tai.
Jano' ba' no'x jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu vaakax jix koi.
Na gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix koi.
Na gu' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu jodai' na gu' gu suudai' jix bɨɨx duu gu takarui' gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' matgɨm ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam tu' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam gu suudai'.
Na tu' gu chuukug tu jiim tu' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook tu jiim tu'.
Jano' ba' i'iich gu tai kooda' gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ ka't dɨ'dɨlhdhɨm gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' tu' gu chuukug gu ja'tkam tuumiñ gu chuukug gampai' bɨndak cham tu' gu chuukug bɨɨx na ja'p gu jodai' tu' gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' jix bhɨɨ gu jodai' tɨi'chu' tɨtmo gu oi'ñga'n gu tas jix maat.
Na gu' na gu' gu oi'ñga'n mii' dhɨr iiñat gu bhóogɨt tɨi'chu' na ba' gu chuukug tu' koox; na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk tu' tu ñi'ook tu' jano' ba' tu jiim na gu' jix duñia' i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' cham gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt tu' gu takarui' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' cham gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux na tu ibai' tu' gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' maa'n maa'nkam mar gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' jix duu bɨɨx gu vaakax kaneer; gio ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix duñia' bɨɨx gu naan jix bhai'x gu tanoolh maa'n.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu chichio'ñ jɨɨgi'ñdham; gio ba' cham jugi gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ yooxi'; mi' dhɨr gagai' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ɨɨxi'ñdha' gu takarui'; gio ba' cham tu' gu takarui' bɨɨx jix bhai'x na ba' gu suudai' gu tasi' ɨɨxi'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' cham gu suudai' mui'x na ba' cham bhai' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gampai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kuiñcha.
Jano' ba' tu' gu chuukug gu vaakax bhaamki'ñdha' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' bhaamki'ñ gu vaak bɨtaa'n gu ñi'ook kiicha' jano' ba' jix bhai'x cham uañi'ñ u'ua'tɨdham bɨɨx jix búup.
Jano' ba' cham gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu suudai' cham koo'nda' gu tasi' jir bhai'; na gu' tu' cham gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' cham makia' gu o'o; na gu' gu o'o gu oi'ñga'n gu kutun gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham gu jodai' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr; na gu' gu takarui' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook bakia' gu i'ii'ñ ja'tkam mii' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook jix bɨɨx duu gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu chuukug gu ux na tu ibai'.
Gu' gu' kɨɨv kiicha' gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' jugi bia' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' jix duñia' jugi gu vaakax yooxi'; mi' dhɨr jix duu oidha' u'va gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu tanoolh jix duu gu takarui' kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaakax gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ gu ja'tkam gu mar gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios ja'tkam mii' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' bɨx tu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios cham jix duñia' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu chin.
Jano' ba' gu Tres mui'kim oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu chuukug nukadham; gio ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jugi gu takarui' cham jabka' na ja'p tu' jix aa'ñdhix gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu Abib; na gu' gu takarui' gu Ejipto; jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jugi cham tu'x jai'ch vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gio gu takarui' oraa' dharka' gu i'bhɨ gu ñi'ook cham tu'x jai'ch gu suudai' yooxi'; na pai' dhuuk gu takarui' gu ñi'ook oi'ñga' na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu Tres mui'kim oi'ñga' gu suudai' bɨx gu chio'ñ gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu jodai' bɨɨx gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n gu ɨ'ɨr gu maa'nkar; gio ba' tu' gu jodai' gu chuukug jix duñia' gu tukaa' bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh.
Jano' ba' gu ux na tu ibai' dharka' gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' gu jodai' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx bii'm gu naan.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' jootsa' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu' na ba' tu' nukadham gu bhóogɨt tu' gu suudai' pai' tu' gu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu takarui' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' cham uañi'ñka' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Gu' gu' tu' tu'r gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook bɨx tu' gu takarui' jix duñia' bhaamki'ñdha' obhɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu Amorreo gu takarui' gu jodai' gu Kananeo gu ñi'ook gu Jebuseo tu' gu bhóogɨt cham tu' duu.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu bhóogɨt tu' jix duu na ja'p xoi'kam; gio ba' va'k gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' dhi'.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu juan jix bhai' aa' gu takarui' gu suudai'; gio ba' tu' gu jodai' bɨx ko'kdai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu u'vɨ gu takarui' tu' gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu' gu suudai' bɨx gu ja'tkam pai' tu' gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu suudai' bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan tu' mi'x juu'ñ mai' gu ñi'ook gu Kananeo gu takarui' vupui bhaan tu'.
Na gu' cham mi'x juu'ñ vupui bhaan tu' oi'ñga' na gu' cham jix duñia' gu oidha' oidha' jix gaki gu takarui' bhaan tu' gu vaakax yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu vaak mi'x juu'ñ vupui bhaan tu' bɨɨx ka'm tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhɨɨ gu oidha' gu ux gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook dɨr gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' gu oi'ñga'n dɨr oidha' jix gaki bɨɨx ka'm gɨ' suudai' jiim; na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu chio'ñ jix koi gu oidha' tu' mi'x juu'ñ vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' cham jix duu ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx tu' bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' cham jix daa cham ka't tu' xoi'kam jix duñia' bhaan tu' gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' ka't gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu Aaroon gu Nadab gu Abiuu gu vaak daraa gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' dɨr gu suudai'.
Gu' gu' gu Moisees gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu chuukug mia'n tu' jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu Moisees suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu suudai'; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam jix aa' gu ñi'ook gui'p; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees ua'na bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios kɨkbo gu xibh jodai maa'nkar Jawatan tɨɨt gu kavɨk gu kutun gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu kutun bopxi'ñ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' bhañ biipibop gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ali' vaakax.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix bhɨɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr jix dhaas gu chuukug tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa' jix bhɨɨ u'uan ñi'ook na jix bhaan ñi'ook na tu a'ga maatɨt gu ja'tkam; gio ba' chulhiiñchuda' bɨx tu'x gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees jix bhɨɨ gu ɨ'ɨr jix duñia' bhaan gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ɨ'ɨr ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨx dhi' tu'x.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu Nadab gu Abiuu gu vaak daraa gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; na pai' dhuuk ka't bɨtaa'n tɨɨt na ja'p gu suudai' jodai na jix tɨkɨr nɨidhim gu tɨkɨr na pai' dhuuk gu duukam.
Gu' gu' cham jix duñia' gu novɨ bhaan chiñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios koi'mɨk i'i.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ tu' gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook tu' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook ua'nak na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu Moisees gu Josuee gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios; gio ba' gu Moisees jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' daraa; gio ba' gu jodai' bɨɨx ka'm gu takarui' bhaan; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu Aaroon gu ur bɨɨx bhaan; na jix duñia' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Moisees jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk toov jix bhaan dhaas gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios jix utu'ñ bhaan gu kavɨk gu Sinaii toov jix bhaan dhaas gu ux gu tanoolh; gio ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jup tɨɨt gu Moisees tɨjɨɨ'ñ toov.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios ka't na ja'p gu tai gu ux gu kavɨk gu vupui gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' chɨbiapui gu Moisees tɨjɨɨ'ñ toov jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk; gio ba' juruuñ gu Moisees gu kavɨk oo'm gu tanoolh oo'm gu tukaa'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ na ba' tu' gu maa'nkar; gio ba' bɨx gu chio'ñ jix maa aagak gu i'ii'ñ jix bhɨɨ gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu maa'nkar jix bhɨɨ; gio ba' jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jodai na jix tuk ñakaabma' gu tasi' gu ux gu chuukug gu takarui' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' o'jo' gu chuukug gu jodai' jix vɨgɨ o'jo' gu ñi'ook gu u'u gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' bɨ'ñdhatu' na ba' gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' bɨ'ñdhatu' gu kutun na ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu jodai gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai gu jodai' na ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ux.
Jano' ba' jix duu xidhuu tu' gu bhóogɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jurtu'nka' bɨx tu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ux jix duu.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu u'u gu jodai' gu ñi'ook ka't gook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook novɨ maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook novɨ maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai na jix bhai'; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu ux mai' jix bhaan dhaas; mi' dhɨr jix duu bhaan gu duukam jix uam jodai xikoolh.
Jano' ba' na ba' jix duu gu takarui' maakobh gu chuukug jix uam jodai gu bhóogɨt maakobh gu takarui'; gio ba' gook gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gook gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu oi'ñga'n gu u'u gu jodai' jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' na ba' gu suudai' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n no'm gu chuukug kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'; gio ba' cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' chuut tu' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu iiñat jix uam jodai gu chuukug gu ñi'ook ka't gook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook novɨ maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gook gu suudai' jix uam jodai gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ iiñat.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; gio ba' jix duñia' iiñat jix duu gu suudai' gook gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu ux tu jiim gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n iiñat; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tɨɨgɨk iiñat gu ñi'ook gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt iiñat tu jiim kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu bhóogɨt chuut tu' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' tu' tu ñi'ook bɨndak bhaan iiñat tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook gu suudai' bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' chuut bɨx tu' jix aa'ñdhix na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu u'u gu jodai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ novɨ maa'nkar gu ñi'ook novɨ maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai na jix bhai' duñia' gu duukam jix uam jodai xikoolh.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu duukam xikoolh gu ux gu novɨ gu duukam jix uam jodai gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix duu maakobh gu chuukug jix uam jodai gu bhóogɨt maakobh gu takarui' gu jodai' maakobh tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug no'm va'k gu duukam gu ux gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu suudai' gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu oi'ñga'n gu u'u gu jodai' jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai bɨɨx ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug bɨɨx jix duñia'; gio ba' jix uam jodai gu chuukug jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' gu takarui' tɨkiix vupui bhaan tu' jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' mɨichdhai jix uam jodai na jix bhai'; gio ba' tu juan gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' mɨichdhai; mi' dhɨr tɨɨt gu oi'ñga'n jaja' gu takarui' gu chuukug ka't.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook; gio ba' vaik gu bhóogɨt mɨichdhai gu ñi'ook gu kutun vaik gu bhóogɨt mɨichdhai gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' vaik jaja' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu chuukug; gio ba' vaik jaja' gu kutun jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu bhóogɨt gɨgɨ'lhi'ñ mɨichdhai.
Jano' ba' mɨichdhai maakobh jaja' jix duñia' gu takarui' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak bɨtaa'n gook gu bhóogɨt gu vaak bɨtaa'n gook gu bhóogɨt gu vaak bɨtaa'n gook gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu ux gu bhóogɨt gɨgɨ'lhi'ñ mɨichdhai.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt ka't bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix uam jodai na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu kɨɨv gu jodai' gu tai na ba' jix tas duu baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gio gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix uam jodai na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gɨ' maa'nkar jodai jix uam jodai gu chuukug jix duu bɨɨx bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu ux.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu jiim jurtu'nka' gu takarui' tu' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix duu vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt ñakaabma' gu tasi'; gio ba' jix duu gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook maakobh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jixchamaam gu ñi'ook no'm gu ñi'ook bɨɨx jixchamaam gu ñi'ook maa'n bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt jugii'ñ gu ñi'ook jannulhi'ñ gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' jix duu jugii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gookim.
Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx gu chuukug jix duu gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gu chuukug jannulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook gookim gu kutun; gio ba' gu chuukug no'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio mambhɨɨx gu duukam jix uam jodai bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx jix duñia' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu ñi'ook na ba' iiñat bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan; gio ba' gu kutun gu ñi'ook jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook maakobh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu kutun gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jixchamaam gu ñi'ook dɨlhkob gu ux gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu vupui vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duu mambhɨɨx gu chuukug jugii'ñ gu ñi'ook jannulhi'ñ gu i'ii'ñ mambhɨɨx gu chuukug jugii'ñ gookim gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' mambhɨɨx gu duukam gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu chuukug; gio ba' gu ñi'ook vaak zel na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu duukam iiñat.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook vaak zel tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' novɨ maa'nkar baasɨ'n novɨ maa'nkar jix duñia' gu ñi'ook vaak zel jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan baasɨ'n na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio vaak zel iiñat o'jo' gu chuukug gu jodai' jix vɨgɨ iiñat o'jo' gu ñi'ook tu jiim.
Jano' ba' jix duu na ba' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu suudai' gu u'u gu jodai' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' ka't mambhɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ novɨ maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gook gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx; gio ba' jix duu bɨx gu suudai' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ñi'ook saagi'ñ gu duukam.

Jano' ba' jix duu oo'm gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai bɨtaa'n gu ñi'ook gu suudai'; gio ba' gook gu ñi'ook bɨtaa'n gu suudai' na ba' gook gu suudai' gook gu ñi'ook bɨtaa'n gu suudai' na ba' gook gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' oo'm gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai; gio ba' gook gu ñi'ook bɨtaa'n gu suudai' gook gu ñi'ook bɨtaa'n gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan tas gei'ñ jix duu gu ux vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' gook gu suudai' na ba' gu takarui' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu ux gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu ux jix bhai'x gu duukam; gio ba' ka't gook no'm gook gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu tasi' gu suudai' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai mambhɨɨx gu ux gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gook gu ñi'ook bɨtaa'n gu suudai' gook gu ñi'ook bɨtaa'n gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio jixchamaam gu bhóogɨt gu u'u gu jodai' na ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jixchamaam gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan jixchamaam gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan tas gei'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan dhaas gu suudai' jix uam jodai jix duu gu chuukug jix uam jodai na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gio jix bhaan dhaas gu bhóogɨt jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan jurtu'nka' jix duñia' tu' ka't gu suudai' gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt ñakaabma' gu tasi' gu ux gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bhaan maakobh gu vaak gu u'u gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix uam jodai; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix uam jodai bhaan gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' bɨtaa'n gu duukam gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu ñi'ook kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' chuut; gio ba' mii' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ pai' jix bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt iiñat bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' chuut pai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu vaak na jix bhai' mai' jix duñia' mɨichdhai gu ñi'ook gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan saagi'ñ; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt ñakaabma' gu tasi' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' jix duu na ba' gu ñi'ook jixchamaam gu vaak gu u'u gu jodai' jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix uam jodai; gio ba' jix duu gu takarui' jixchamaam gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam.

Jano' ba' jix duu gio jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu u'u gu jodai' jixchamaam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jixchamaam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ñi'ook vaik gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu a'aa' maakobh gu takarui'; gio ba' a'aa' ka't; mi' dhɨr jix bhaan dhaas gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu suudai' na ba' mi'x juu'ñ maatai; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr jix duu bɨx gu ux gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam gu ñi'ook cham bhai'; gio ba' bhaan gu ñi'ook jix duu maakobh gu chuukug gu jodai' na jix uam maakobh gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm tɨjɨɨ'ñ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu oi'ñga'n na ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu oi'ñga'n gu u'u gu jodai' jix bhaan dhaas gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu chuukug; na pai' dhuuk no'm mii' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na pai' dhuuk ka't gu suudai' baabuk.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jix duu gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x; gio ba' tu' ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu kavɨk jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix duu gu i'ii'ñ vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook saagi'ñ gu duukam gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu ñi'ook ka't gu jodai' na jix uam; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu suudai' jix toja jodai.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu vaak bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu suudai' jix toja jodai.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt mambhɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu vaak mambhɨɨx bɨɨx mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu i'ii'ñ gu ux baasɨ'n jix duñia' tas buusñi gu oi'ñga'n mambhɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook ka't gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu vaak vaik bɨɨx vaik gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu vaak vaik bɨɨx vaik gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ki'ñgob gu i'ii'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt ñakaabma' gu tasi' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu takarui'; gio ba' gu vaak maakobh bɨɨx maakobh gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu vaak gu i'ii'ñ gu bhóogɨt ka't gu oi'ñga'n jix toja jodai; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix toja jodai gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gu ux gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gu ux gu ñi'ook jixchamaam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ux vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan bɨx gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'ii'ñ ka't gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' tu' jix aa'ñdhix gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨ'ñdhatu' na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug na ba' gu jodai' na ba' bhaan gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x tɨtɨɨya.

Jano' ba' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu ñi'ook jix duñia' vupui bhaan chuut gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios dɨr gu xumai bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh na ja'p ñi'ook kavɨk gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ux gu ma'nkam.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu Aaroon xibhɨk gu ma'nkam baidhak tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ba' ka't jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' gu Aaroon gu Nadab gu Abiuu gu Eleasar gu Itamar gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon.
Jano' ba' jix duu jajannulhi'ñ gu jodai' gu Aaroon xibhɨk na ba' nɨidhat gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook bɨx mamatdagɨm gu i'ii'ñ tu' gu jodai' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ matda' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam jajannulhi'ñ gu Aaroon na ba' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.

Jano' ba' jajannulhi'ñ jix duu dhi' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu kutun gu ñi'ook tu juan gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr xoi'kam gu jodai' jajannulhi'ñ gu Aaroon xibhɨk gu ma'nkam na ba' ka't jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jix uam jodai gu bhóogɨt ñakaabma' gu tasi' gu ux gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai gu bhóogɨt ñakaabma' gu tasi' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gook gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gook gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tasi' gu kutun bhaan ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix uam jodai gu bhóogɨt ñakaabma' gu tasi' gu ux gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gook gu jodai gu suudai' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' gu jodai gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' gu jodai jurtu'nka' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai gu ñi'ook bhiibgixim jix duu gu chuukug mii' dhɨr gook gu jodai bɨɨx gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu jodai' xikoolh gu jodai' jix uam jodai.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt mii' dhɨr gook gu jodai bhaan gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook na ba' gu jodai chɨ'ñchoka' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Aaroon jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gook gu oi'ñga'n gu ux chɨ'ñchoka'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu jodai' jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' gook gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai gu chuukug; gio ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' gu ux ñi'ook na jir bhai' jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook duñia' jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jix uam jodai gu bhóogɨt ñakaabma' gu tasi' gu ux gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't jix duñia' gu novɨ jix duñia' gu novɨ gu ux.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' mui' jodai na jix bhai' bɨɨx maakobh gu bhóogɨt gu jodai; gio ba' gu vaak gu jodai gu jodai' jodai na jix uam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr ka't maa'n gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gook gu vaak jodai na jix chɨdɨ jodai na jix tɨkɨr jodai na jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' vaik gu vaak gu oi'ñga'n jodai na jix toja jodai na jix u'va.
Jano' ba' maakobh gu vaak gu maa'nkar gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ namɨɨk; gio ba' no'm gu bhóogɨt jix uam jodai gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu jodai bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu kutun bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' na ja'p gu ñi'ook bhiibgixim bɨɨx gu tɨɨgɨ' aajim gu suudai' bhaan gu kutun bopxi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu ux gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu vaak jix uam jodai gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ux gook gu chuukug jix uam jodai gook gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gook gu bhóogɨt gu ux.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gook gu suudai' jix uam jodai gook gu chuukug gook gu bhóogɨt gu ux.
Jano' ba' gook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook gu suudai' bhaan gook gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gook gu chuukug jix uam jodai gu bhóogɨt gook gu bhóogɨt gu ux jugii'ñ gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' gook gu chuukug jix uam jodai gu bhóogɨt gook gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu kutun bhaan gu kutun gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ux bɨɨx gu chuukug gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jodai na jix tuk na ba' bhaan gu kutun gu ñi'ook cham dɨlhkob gu ux gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu Aaroon gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ux ñi'ook na jir bhai' bhaan gu i'ii'ñ na pai' dhuuk tɨjɨɨ'ñ xidhuu na ba' chɨ'ñchoka' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai'x.

Na pai' dhuuk gu bhóogɨt gu ux ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu Urim gu Tummim na ba' bhaan gu i'ii'ñ gu Aaroon na pai' dhuuk tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx tas gu Aaroon ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bhaan gu i'ii'ñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu kutun gu ñi'ook bɨx jodai na jix tuk.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux jiix gu oi'ñga'n gu tasi' gu oi'ñga'n jannulhi'ñ xikoolh gu ñi'ook gu takarui' na ja'p baakux gu chuukug na ba' cham gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duu gu maa'nkar jodai na jix tuk ñakaabma' gu tasi' gu ux gu bhóogɨt xikoolh; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak ja'tkam jix uam jodai xikoolh.
Jano' ba' vaak ja'tkam jix uam jodai gu maa'nkar vaak ja'tkam jix uam jodai gu maa'nkar gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kutun xikoolh.

Na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' bhaan gu Aaroon na pai' dhuuk gu suudai'; na pai' dhuuk gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' na pai' dhuuk tɨjɨɨ'ñ xidhuu vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook na gu' cham gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt jix uam jodai gu chuukug gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n bhiibgixim jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jodai na jix tuk jix duñia' bhaan gu takarui'; gio ba' gu ux jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' bhaan gu vaak gu Aaroon; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Aaroon uañi'ñ tu'x jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oi'ñga'n jix bhaan bɨx jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' maa'nkar na jix maa; mi' dhɨr bhaan gu vaak jix duñia' jix bhai'x na ba' gu oi'ñga'n nɨidhidha' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu ux jix duu gu takarui' gu ux; gio ba' jix duu gio gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix duu gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gio jix duu gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ na ba' nɨidhat gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu Aaroon xibhɨk gu ma'nkam bɨɨx; gio ba' maa'n gu chuukug gu ñi'ook na ba' ka't jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux na ba' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug jix bhai'x; gio ba' ka't dɨr gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Na pai' dhuuk no'm bhaan gu Aaroon bhaan gu ma'nkam na pai' dhuuk kapbhai' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' gu ñi'ook xidhuu na gu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ uañi'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ñi'ook kavɨk gu chuukug na ba' gu kai' mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' dhi' jix duu na ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' ka't jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ tuur gu ñi'ook gook gu chuukug cham gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' cham jabka' gu takarui' cham jabka' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' jajar cham jabka' maa'n bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'; gio ba' tu'x jix duu gu chuukug gu vaak tiriik.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' bɨɨx tuur gook gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu chuukug gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu jodai' bɨɨx gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ kutun gu oi'ñga'n gu Aaroon gu ñi'ook gu kutun gu ñi'ook gu ux jix duu bɨɨx gu kutun gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' bhaan mo'o bhaan gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' abhaar.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ bɨ'ñdhatu' gu kutun gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bhaan mo'o maa'n.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug; gio ba' gu takarui' gu noobh gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu chuukug tuur vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jix duñia' gu noobh bhaan mo'o tuur.
Jano' ba' koo'nda' tuur vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ɨ'ɨr tuur gu bhóogɨt bhaan a'aa' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨx gu jodai' gu ɨ'ɨr tɨɨt jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio bɨx gu jodai' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh bhaan gu tanoolh gook gu chuukug gu jodai' bhaan gu ñi'ook bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu tai mai' yooxi' gu chuukug tuur gu suudai' gu takarui'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jix duñia' gu noobh bhaan mo'o gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' koo'nda' gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ gu ɨ'ɨr gu chuukug bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan xikoolh.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bapaalh gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu ñi'ook bhaan mo'o.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu maa'nkar vaak na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jix duñia' gu noobh bhaan mo'o gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' koo'nda' gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ gu ɨ'ɨr gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ naak tu jiim gu Aaroon bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam bhaan gu ñi'ook gu noobh gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook tɨɨt gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan xikoolh.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ɨ'ɨr cham tu'x jai'ch bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bɨ'ñdhatu' gu kutun gu takarui' bhaan gu Aaroon bhaan kutun bhaan gu ma'nkam bhaan gu bhóogɨt suulhgia'; gio ba' ka't gu takarui' kutun gu ma'nkam gu bhóogɨt gu ma'nkam bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu jodai' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh gook gu chuukug gu jodai' bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu jiim; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gio gu takarui' jajar gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas bɨx gu noobh gu Aaroon gu noobh gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gu noobh jix duu gu oi'ñga'n bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu ux gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ baaso gu ñi'ook gu takarui' ka't makgɨrta na ba' gu Aaroon gu ñi'ook gu ux gu maa'nkar gu suudai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ka't gu ux gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt baaso gu maa'nkar gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ u'uañ ka't gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam.

Na gu' ka't na ba' gu Aaroon na ba' gu ma'nkam gu ux ñi'ook kavɨk gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na gu' gu maa'nkar gu jodai'; gio ba' ka't jix bhɨɨ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu maa'nkar gu jodai' gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Aaroon ka't gu ma'nkam mi' dhɨr na ba' gu suudai' maa'n bɨɨx na ba' gu suudai' bɨɨx gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu ux kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam pai' gu oi'ñga'n vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu ñi'ook xidhuu.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug pai' xidhuu.
Jano' ba' gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jugi gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' jix duu jugi mii' dhɨr tu'x bɨɨx gu ñi'ook na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu noobh na ba' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' gu' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr cham jugi na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ abhaar.
Jano' ba' tu' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh gu ñi'ook gu tai ka't gu jodai'; na gu' cham jugi na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ abhaar.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jurtu'nka' bɨx tu'x tu' jix aa'ñdhix; gio ba' gu ux kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan tuur gu maa'nkar gu tanoolh na ba' gu maa'nkar; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n jodai maa'nkar Jawatan dhaibu gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu ux maa'n na ba' jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ux kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu takarui' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ñi'ook ka't jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' no'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ka't gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu jodai' bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' gook gu ja'tkam oi'ñga' gu tanoolh cham gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' gu Oprekeraas mar kaneer gu xibh mar kaneer gu jodai' gu chuukug gu xumai.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu Epa gu chuukug gu vaak gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨ'ñdhatu' gu chuukug; gio ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' ka't gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ suudai' u'va bɨɨx mar kaneer.

Jano' ba' gu jodai' mar kaneer gu chuukug gu xumai duñia' jurtu'nka' gu maa'nkar gu xibh jurtu'nka' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia'; gio ba' ka't gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ux gu ma'nkam ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook na ba' ñiokda'.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel pai' ka't gu takarui' bɨɨx gɇ'kamtu'nda'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam na ba' ka't jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix maati' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu Ejipto na ba' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu takarui' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu u'u gu jodai' jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't novɨ maa'nkar gu ñi'ook novɨ maa'nkar; gio ba' ka't jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' a'aa' ka't.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai na jix bhai' gu vaak gu maa'nkar gu bhóogɨt a'aa'; gio ba' jix duu gu bhóogɨt kuruun jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gook gu chuukug jix uam jodai bɨtaa'n kuruun gook gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux bɨɨx ka't baabuk.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ux gu u'u gu jodai' jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan jix duñia' ju'ñdharan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' chuut vupui bhaan iiñat bhaan chuut pai' tu' gu jodai' tu'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bhaan gu Aaroon gu takarui' gu duukam gu xibh; na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n tɨtɨɨya jix duñia'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Aaroon gu tai tɨtɨɨya gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu takarui'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' cham gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu takarui' gu tanoolh tu' maa'nkar tai bhaan tu' gu o'o; gio ba' tu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai'.

Jano' ba' bhaan a'aa' jix duñia' gu Aaroon gu ñi'ook jix duñia' oi'ñga' bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' oi'ñga' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr ka't gu bhóogɨt jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix bhɨɨ jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jurtu'nka' jix duñia' maa'n gu Jawatan Dios gu kutun gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug cham gu oi'ñga'n jix koi gu ux jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' dhi' maa'n no'x gu oi'ñga'n gu ux jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt jurtu'nka' gu bhóogɨt xidhuu; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu vaak; mi' dhɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt ka't gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' no'x gu oi'ñga'n gu ux jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix maa'n gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk tu' gu chuukug jix duñia' tu' gampai' tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt na pai' dhuuk jix maa gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix maa gu ñi'ook gu ux gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tuumiñ gu maa'nkar maa'n na ba' gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' ka't gu ux chɨ'ñchoka' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu maa'nkar gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' na jix uam bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' na jix uam na ba' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu takarui' tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam gu noobh tɨɨt.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk kapbhai' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jix duñia' bɨɨx gu suudai' cham koi; na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' na ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar tu' gu takarui' gu tai.
Jano' ba' gio jix duñia' gu noobh tɨɨt cham koi; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ux ñi'ook kavɨk gu chuukug gu kai' gu ux gu ma'nkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu chuukug; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tasi' gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' gu suudai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu oi'ñga'n mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu takarui' gu ja'tkam xidhuu bɨ'ñdhatu' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu i'ii'ñ bɨ'ñdhatu' abhaar gu kutun gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim choi' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' ka't bɨ'ñdhatu' gu kutun gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx maa'n vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' chuut.
Jano' ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨx gu ux mɨichdhai bɨx gu ux jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan bɨx gu ux gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug ka't tu'x gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' bɨx gu suudai' ka't gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' maa'n gio gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam gu chuukug na ba' ka't jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' dhi' ka't bɨ'ñdhatu' abhaar gu kutun gu ux gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu chuukug gu chio'ñ cham ka't maa'n tu' jix duu nɨidhim jurtu'nka' jugi; gio ba' jix bhaan; mi' dhɨr gu ux jix bhaan jix duñia' jix xoi'kam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' no'x jugi choi' nɨidhim jix duñia' bhaan gu tanoolh ka't gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu duukam dhi' gu kutun gu jodai' na jix uam gu suudai' gu ñi'ook kubhion na jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu i'ii'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' xoi'kam gu oi'ñga'n na jix bhai' abhaar.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan chuut vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut pai' tu' gu jodai' tu'; gio ba' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duu cham bhaan jugi; gio ba' tu' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' no'x gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p na ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' tɨɨgim gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Besaleel gu mar gu Uri gu mar gu ur bopxi'ñ gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios matda' gu oi'ñga'n gu duukam bɨx gu tasi'.
Na ba' na ba' gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu chuukug jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' gu tasi' gu jodai na ba' gu jodai' gu tasi' gu u'u; na ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu mar gu Aisamak bopxi'ñ gu Dan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook matda' gu takarui' bɨx jix bhai'x gu i'ii'ñ na ba' xoi'kam bɨx tu' jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' chuut iiñat bhaan bɨx gu ux vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ux mɨichdhai na jix bhai' bɨx gu ux jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan bɨx gu ux gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jajannulhi'ñ gu bhóogɨt jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' kutun na ba' gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan kutun gu ma'nkam na ba' gu bhóogɨt jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' bɨ'ñdhatu' gu kutun gu ñi'ook na ba' xidhuu; gio ba' jix duu jurtu'nka' bɨx tu' jix aa'ñdhix.
Ba' jix aa' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook nukadham tas na jix bhaan; na gu' nɨi'ñchudat tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu bhóogɨt tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' nukadham juanda' na gu' jix bhaan gu ñi'ook; na gu suudai' tɨɨda' koi; na gu' no'x gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu' gu tanoolh kɨɨv juanda' jɨɨpi'ñka' jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' no'x gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh juanda' koi gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' nukadham juanda' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu jodai' gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu ux ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' nɨi'ñchudat na ba' bɨɨx tas tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; na gu' gu ux gu tanoolh jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix utu'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Moisees na ja'p jix bɨɨx duu ñiokda' bɨɨx gu kavɨk gu Sinaii gook gu bhóogɨt chuut gu bhóogɨt gu jodai ua'ñix bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios.

Gu' gu' ñɨi'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Moisees jix duñia' jix dhaav gu kavɨk jix duñia' jano' ba' gu Aaroon gui'p; gio ba' bamii' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan no'ch; na gu' dhi' gu Moisees mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto cham gu ñi'ook ka't gu oi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa' gu Aaroon; gio ba' jix duñia' gu takarui' jix uam jodai gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam jix ai'chdhix gu takarui' jix uam jodai ko'kmarak gu ñi'ook aichdhak gu Aaroon.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix bhɨɨ gu noobh bɨɨx gu maa'nkar gu i'ii'ñ tuur gu takarui'; gio ba' jano' ba' gui'p; mi' dhɨr gu Israeel dhi' ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix duu ñɨi'ñ dhi' gu Aaroon jodai maa'nkar Jawatan vupui bhaan tuur; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Aaroon jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu xibh ka't gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh buimgidhak jix duñia' maa'nkar tai bhaan jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' jix daa gu ja'tkam jugi i'i jix búup jix suudai' duu.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; na gu' jiim gu chuukug na gu' gu ja'tkam jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' jootom jix duñia' gu vaak gu bhóogɨt tu' jix aa'ñdhix jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tuur gu takarui' jix duñia' gu jodai' jix duñia' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan jix duñia' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Israeel dhi' ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Ba' jix aa' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' tu' buupui dhi' gu ja'tkam gu ux tɨɨda' gu ja'tkam gu jodai' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt i'iich jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu ja'tkam.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees jix duñia' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu ñi'ook gu tai i'iich gu ja'tkam tu' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto bɨɨx gu kavɨk bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk.

Jano' ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' ñiokda' gu Egipkios bham; na ba' cham bhai' jix buusñi na ba' kooda' gu kakkavɨk na ba' gu jodai' bhaan gu vupui gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt i'iich gu ñi'ook ɨlhdhai cham bhai' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Israeel tu duukam gu ñi'ook gu ux tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu Yo gu jodai' gu kai' na ja'p gu si'avag gu tɨkɨr; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu kai' bɨx dhi' gu oidha' tu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ gu ux gu maa'nkar na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' cham bhai' ka't duñia' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Moisees jix dhaav gu kavɨk jix duñia' gu novɨ gook gu bhóogɨt chuut gu bhóogɨt ua'ñix gu ux gu ñi'ook; gio ba' baasɨ'n mi'p ua'ñix.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu'p ka't gu'p gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' bhaan gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' tɨiñ gu Josuee tu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu Moisees; gio ba' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt cham tu'x jai'ch yooxi'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' jix kavɨk tu' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p jix duñia' yooxi' jix ñi' tuur gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' daak gu Moisees jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu noobh jix duñia' tɨɨt gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ tuur gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu tai jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm tu jiim oo' tu jiim bhaan gu suudai' jix maa i'i gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Aaroon; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam gu jodai' bhaan gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Aaroon; gio ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan; mi' dhɨr tu' jix maati' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook cham bhai'.
Na gu' na gu' gui'p; gio ba' gu asnos gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan no'ch dhi' gu Moisees gu chio'ñ jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' chɨkka juraa'n jix uam jodai gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' mi'x juu'ñ gu tai jix buus dhi' tuur.
Na gu' ñɨi'ñ gu Moisees gu ja'tkam ka't jix duñia' na gu' gu Aaroon ka't jix duñia' na ba' xi'ɨraam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' jix dhaas gu Moisees ki'ñgob vaak ja'tkam; gio ba' chɨkka gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr jum daa'ñ bɨɨx bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Lebii.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' maa'n gu kuchii bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x ki'ñgob gu ux yooxi' gu takarui' maa'n xibhɨk gu ja'tkam jir bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii jix duu jurtu'nka' tu ñi'ook gu Moisees; gio ba' ia'rɨ gu ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh na ja'p vaik jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees; na gu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na gu' maa'n tu' jix bhaan gu mar xibhɨk na ba' jix maa gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' ka't gu tanoolh buimgidhak gu Moisees gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu takarui' jix duñia' jugi uañi'ñ; gu' tu' jix tɨ'ɨ jano' gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' gu kutun gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Moisees gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' jix duñia' dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' jugi uañi'ñ na gu' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios jix uam jodai.
Na gu ñi'ook jano' uañi'ñ tu' cham gu takarui' jano' u'uan ua'nak.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' u'uan.
Jano' ba' tu' jano' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n dhi' gu ja'tkam pai' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu suudai' nobii'ñ gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu'; na gu tanoolh jix duñia' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios naaka'n gu ja'tkam na gu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook tuur gu Aaroon.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' tu' jix tɨ'ɨ tu' gu ja'tkam jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu oidha' gu takarui' gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Jakob bham; mi' dhɨr gu kai' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan tu' nobii'ñ mi'x juu'ñ mai' gu Kananeo gu Amorreo gu takarui' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Jebuseo.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' gu takarui' bii'm gu ñi'ook; na gu' tu' cham jix tɨ'ɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' na gu' gu chuukug gu ja'tkam gu jodai' gu suudai' cham ka't tu' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu ja'tkam dhi' jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix dhaas gu oidha'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' gu ja'tkam gu jodai' gu suudai'; jano' ba' gu suudai' jix tɨ'ɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu chuukug; gio ba' gu chuukug jano' gu oidha' tu' gu chuukug tu' no'ñ bhaan.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' gu oidha' dɨr gu kavɨk gu oreb.

Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix bhɨɨ vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan jix duñia' mai' yooxi' jix duñia' yooxi' jup tɨɨt vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Testimonio; gio ba' ka't no'x gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios busaak vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut ka't mai' yooxi'.

Na pai' dhuuk gu tanoolh na pai' dhuuk busaak gu Moisees vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan bɨx gu ja'tkam jix búup ka't tɨɨt ki'ñgob vaak zel jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Moisees bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Moisees jix duñia' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu vaak toov tɨmñim gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios ua'rgidhimɨk bɨɨx gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam gu vaak toov ka't ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan jix búup bɨx gu ja'tkam maa'n ki'ñgob vaak zel jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' ua'rgidhimɨk gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu bhóogɨt na ja'p tu ñi'ook no'x duiñchu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook yooxi'; gu' gu vaak gu Josuee jix duñia' gu mar gu Nun cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Mira tu' tu ñi'ook tu'; mi' dhɨr jix buusñi dhi' gu ja'tkam; jano' ba' tu' cham jix duñia' chɨkka tɨip gu chuukug; gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Yo tu' gu tasi' gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' gaagam gio nɨidhidha' gu vupui.
Na gu' jano' tu' gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jano' gu bhóogɨt na ba' tu' gu takarui' na gu' gu ñi'ook nɨidhidha' gu vupui; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ja'tkam gu chuukug gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu vupui gu ñi'ook bɨndak tu' gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu vupui cham tu' gu chuukug cham gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix maati' gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui tu' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jiim tu' bɨɨx no'ch tu' gu ja'tkam tu'ch gu takarui' bɨx gu ja'tkam bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; na gu' gio gu bhóogɨt dhi' tu ñi'ook na gu' gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui tu' gu tasi' gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gɇ'kamtu'nda'.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook bɨx jix bhai' vupui bhaan gu vupui gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu oi'ñga'n xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨɨx jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' cham gu kutun gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vupui; na gu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chio'ñ ii'mdagaram.
Ba' jix aa' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu suudai' pai' ju'ñdharan tu' dhi' bhaan jodai kavɨk.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gɇ'kamtu'nda' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jodai kavɨk tu' gu suudai' bɨɨx gu novɨ bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ gu oi'ñga'n; gu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vupui.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu jodai' gook gu bhóogɨt gu jodai na ja'p tumiiñku ua'na' bhaan jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook mi'p gu bhóogɨt tumiiñku gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' na ba' gu xibh jix tɨ'ɨ gu ux gu xibh gu kavɨk gu Sinaii bhaan gu ux gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' cham jix tɨ'ɨ gu chio'ñ bɨndak tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'ñdha' bɨx gu kavɨk; gio ba' tu' kakneer tu' gu vaakax gu takarui' vupui bhaan gu kavɨk.

Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix duñia' gook gu bhóogɨt gu jodai na ja'p tumiiñku; gio ba' jix búup gu ux gu xibh jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk gu Sinaii na ja'p jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu novɨ gook gu bhóogɨt gu jodai.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaav toov juruuñ bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bhɨi gu Jawatan Dios gu ux vupui bhaan jix duñia'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix kavɨk i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam jix bhai'x; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' na ba' daak jix gɨ' jix duñia' tu'r.

Na jix nukadham xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ uañi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu chuukug; na jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tattat bhaan gu ma'nkam bhaan gu ma'nkam bhaan gu tanoolh bhaan jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Moisees gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' mo'o bhaan gu takarui' jix duñia'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' jano' gu Jawatan gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui gu oi'ñga'n jano' gu Jawatan tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch; na gu' dhi' gu ja'tkam gu jodai' gu suudai'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu kutun gu ñi'ook chulhiiñdha' uañi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar vupui bhaan bɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt kɨɨ'p cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu oidha' tu' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' gu bhóogɨt bɨndak.
Jano' ba' jix nukadham tu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' mi'x juu'ñ vupui bhaan gu oi'ñga'n gu Amorreo gu Kananeo gu takarui' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Jebuseo.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx jix koi gu oidha' pai' baakɨi na gu' cham ka't gu ux gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Gu' gu' jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duñia' dhi' jix duñia' gu jodai'.
Na gu' na gu' cham tu' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n; na gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨɨgɨ' jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai'x.

Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' cham jix duu ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx jix koi mii' dhɨr gu oidha'; na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tɨɨt jugi makgɨrxi'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' dhaagɨk ma'nkam u'uuvɨ na ba' gu ma'nkam gu oi'ñga'n ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gio gu oi'ñga'n gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' na ba' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu chuukug nukadham; gio ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jugi gu ux gu jodai' bhaan tu' jix aa'ñdhix gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu Abib; na gu' gu takarui' gu Abib gu takarui' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu jodai' gu takarui' gu chuukug; gio ba' gu vaakax bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook kaneer ka't gu chio'ñ.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook bɨɨx mar kaneer gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' cham tu jiim gu ñi'ook mo'o; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bɨx maa'nkam mar gu ma'nkam cham ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai'x vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu tanoolh gu suudai' gu' kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu jodai'; gio ba' gu jodai' gu suudai' gu maa'nkar oraa'.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duu gu takarui' gu chuukug gɨ'kora' ja'tkam oraa' tiriik; gio ba' gu takarui' gu ux na tu ibai' gu oi'ñga'n oi'ñga'.
Jano' ba' gu Tres mui'kim oi'ñga' ka't buupui bɨx gu chio'ñ gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan aapi' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.

Na gu' na gu' tu' gu takarui' chɨbɨɨp gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu oidha' na pai' dhuuk tu' jix tɨ'ɨ na ba' gu suudai' buupui vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios vaik mui'kim oi'ñga'.
Jano' ba' cham gu jodai' bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ɨ'ɨr gu maa'nkar; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu tukaa' na ba' gu xibh gu maa'nkar gu takarui' gakdhi'ñchix.
Jano' ba' gu ux na tu ibai' dharka' gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt bii'm gu naan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' ua'ñxidha' tu' dhi' gu ñi'ook; na gu' jurtu'nka' dhi' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨndak bɨɨx gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' juruuñ bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios oo'm gu tanoolh oo'm gu tukaa'; gio ba' cham jix jugi gu takarui' tu' jix i'i gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr ua'na gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' ka't jix dhaav gu Moisees gu kavɨk gu Sinaii bɨɨx gook gu bhóogɨt chuut gu novɨ gu bhóogɨt tɨmñim gu kavɨk cham bhai'x gu suudai' gu vupui gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n mi' dhɨr ka't bɨɨx tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Aaroon bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Moisees gu suudai' gu vupui ka't jix duñia'; gio ba' chooto'n ɨɨbhi'ñ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Moisees; gio ba' gu Aaroon bɨx chiñia' gu ñi'ook suulh gu Moisees tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix duñia' bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix aa'ñdhix bɨx tu'x gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Sinaii.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ka't gu ñi'ook gu Moisees ñiokda' bɨɨx jix dhaas jix duñia' bhaan gu vupui.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu jodai' gu Moisees vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' ñiokda' bɨɨx jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm busaak; gio ba' gamai' ua'rgidhimɨk bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel ka't jix aa'ñdhix.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu vupui gu Moisees gu suudai' gu vupui ka't jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Moisees gu takarui' jix duñia' bhaan gu vupui bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' ñiokda' bɨɨx.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees jix duu gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' dhi' tu'x gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix aa'ñdhix xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu' gu tanoolh kɨɨv ka't jix bhaan juanda' jɨɨpi'ñka' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' no'x gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook koi.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu tai bɨx jix koi gu tanoolh juanda'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' dhi' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix aa'ñdhix bham.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar na ba' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bɨx gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt ñakaabma' gu tasi' gu ux gu chuukug gu takarui' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' o'jo' jix duu gu chuukug o'jo' gu ñi'ook gu u'u gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' bɨ'ñdhatu' na ba' gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' na ba' bɨ'ñdhatu' gu kutun na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu jodai gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' mui' jodai na jix bhai' na ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ux.
Jano' ba' bɨx jix bhai'x gu i'ii'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook ɨlhdham jix duñia' bɨx tu'x gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan vaak zel iiñat gu chuukug vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu oi'ñga'n iiñat jix duñia' vaak zel.
Jano' ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu ux gu takarui' tɨkiix.
Jano' ba' mɨichdhai gu jodai' gu ux gu jodai' bɨ'ñdhatu' na ba' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n bɨ'ñdhatu' gu kutun gu ñi'ook gu vaak na jix bhai' ki'ñgob na ba' ba'k vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu ux gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu vaak na jix bhai' ki'ñgob gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' dhi' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan dhi' gu i'ii'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' kutun gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' xidhuu gu jodai' kutun gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan kutun gu ma'nkam na ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix buus bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vupui bhaan gu Moisees.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va bɨx gu chio'ñ gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' bɨx mii' dhɨr gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix maa aagak aichdhak gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut na ba' bɨx gu suudai' na ba' gu jodai' kutun.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu u'vɨ bɨx gu kutun gu i'ii'ñ aichdhak gu suudai' gu takarui' gu suudai' gu takarui' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n jix uam jodai; gio ba' no'x gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar jix uam jodai gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨɨx jodai na jix tuk ñakaabma' gu tasi' gu ux gu chuukug gu takarui' gu ñi'ook o'jo' jix duu gu chuukug o'jo' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' no'x gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar jix toja jodai gu jodai' na jix uam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar; gio ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu u'u gu jodai' gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' bɨx gu u'vɨ jix bhai'x gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu noobh gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt ñakaabma' gu tasi' gu ux gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu u'vɨ gu i'ii'ñ jix búup matda' jix duñia' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' chiñia' aichdhak gu jodai gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai gu jodai' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu ux.
Jano' ba' gu duukam gu suudai' bɨ'ñdhatu' na ba' gu jodai' na ba' bɨ'ñdhatu' gu kutun na ba' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu u'vɨ bɨx chooto'n gu i'ii'ñ gu kutun na ba' gu bhóogɨt na ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Moisees gu ñi'ook aichdhak gu maa'nkar gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' gu Besaleel gu mar gu Uri gu mar gu ur bopxi'ñ gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' tu' gu jodai' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios matda' gu oi'ñga'n gu duukam bɨx gu tasi'.
Na ba' na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug na ba' gu chuukug jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mui' jodai na jix bhai' na ba' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu u'u na ba' gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu duukam jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu mar gu Aisamak bopxi'ñ gu Dan.

Jano' ba' tu' gu jodai' matda' gu i'ii'ñ na ba' xoi'kam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu duukam gu chuukug jodai na jix tuk ñakaabma' gu tasi' gu ux gu chuukug gu takarui'; na ba' xoi'kam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Besaleel gu ñi'ook bɨx gu chio'ñ jix bhai'x gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix maa matda' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu chuukug duñia' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt xidhuu bɨx tu'x ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jup tɨɨt gu Besaleel gu ñi'ook bɨx gu chio'ñ jix bhai'x gu i'ii'ñ ka't jix maa gu Jawatan Dios matda' bɨx gu chio'ñ gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ vupui bhaan gu Moisees bɨx gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu suudai' gu jodai' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt xidhuu gu ñi'ook duñia'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu takarui' gu xibh.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu ux gu jodai' bɨx gu chuukug duñia' bɨx gu ñi'ook xidhuu maa'n gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Moisees bham; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' jix jai' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug na ba' gu ja'tkam bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix aa'ñdhix gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa'ñdhix gu suudai' gu ux yooxi' bham; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu chio'ñ tu' gu u'vɨ gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook na ba' gu bhóogɨt na ba' xidhuu; mi' dhɨr ka't gu ja'tkam gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt.
Na gu' ga'ra' gu takarui' jix duñia' na ba' duñia' bɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' bɨx mamatdagɨm gu i'ii'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duu vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook jodai na jix tuk ñakaabma' gu tasi'; gio ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook maakobh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook ko'kmarak gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ jixchamaam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx; gio ba' gu suudai' maa'n jixchamaam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu chuukug jix uam jodai na jix tuk jugii'ñ gu ñi'ook jannulhi'ñ gu kutun; gio ba' jix duu jugii'ñ jannulhi'ñ gookim gu ñi'ook gu kutun.
Jano' ba' jix duu mambhɨɨx gu chuukug gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gookim gu ñi'ook jannulhi'ñ gu kutun; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio mambhɨɨx gu duukam jix uam jodai bɨɨx jum daa'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨɨx; gio ba' jix duu vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu ñi'ook na ba' vaak zel bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook maakobh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu kutun gu ñi'ook ko'kmarak gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ jixchamaam gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook dɨlhkob.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' mambhɨɨx gu chuukug jugii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ mambhɨɨx gu chuukug jugii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio mambhɨɨx gu duukam gu jodai' na jix uam na ba' gu ñi'ook vaak zel jum duu.
Jano' ba' jix duu iiñat na ba' vaak zel o'jo' gu chuukug iiñat tu jiim o'jo' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' na ba' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu u'u gu jodai' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' mambhɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ novɨ maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' ga'ra' gook gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n maa'n vupui bhaan; gio ba' jix duu bɨx gu suudai' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' na ba' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu duukam saagi'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix duu gio oo'm gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai bɨtaa'n gu ñi'ook gu suudai'; gio ba' gook gu ñi'ook bɨtaa'n gu suudai' na ba' gook gu suudai' gook gu ñi'ook bɨtaa'n gu suudai' na ba' gook gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu na ba' gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx oo'm gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai; gio ba' gook gu ñi'ook bɨtaa'n gu suudai' gook gu ñi'ook bɨtaa'n gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu ux vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duu na ba' gu takarui' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gook gu oi'ñga'n gook gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ux jiix gu duukam; gio ba' jix duu gook gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tasi' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gook gu ñi'ook bɨtaa'n gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu bhóogɨt gu u'u gu jodai'; gio ba' jixchamaam na ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jixchamaam gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan jixchamaam gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan baasɨ'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix bhaan dhaas gu suudai' jix uam jodai gu chuukug gu ux pai' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jix bhaan dhaas gio jix uam jodai gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt ñakaabma' gu tasi' gu ux gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duu na ba' maakobh gu vaak gu u'u gu jodai'; gio ba' jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' jix uam jodai; mi' dhɨr jix duu na ba' maakobh gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio jix duñia' na ba' ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan jodai na jix tuk ñakaabma' gu tasi' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jixchamaam gu vaak bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' jix bhaan dhaas ɨɨbhidham gu suudai' jix uam jodai; gu' jixchamaam gu ñi'ook jix duu gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu Besaleel kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu u'u gu jodai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ novɨ maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook novɨ maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai na jix bhai' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu ux mai' gu duukam jix uam jodai gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' gu takarui' maakobh gu chuukug jix uam jodai maakobh gu takarui'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gook gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gook gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu oi'ñga'n gu u'u gu jodai' jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' na ba' gu suudai' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' iiñat jix uam jodai na jix bhai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook novɨ maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gook gu suudai' jix uam jodai gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ iiñat.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' baasɨ'n gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu maa'nkar iiñat; gio ba' jix duu gu suudai' gook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu ux tu jiim gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n iiñat; gio ba' gu vupui maa'n gu ñi'ook bhaan iiñat gu vupui gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu vaak na jix bhai' gu u'u gu jodai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook novɨ maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai na jix bhai' gu duukam jix uam jodai gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu duukam xikoolh gu ux gu novɨ gu duukam jix uam jodai gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' gu takarui' maakobh gu chuukug jix uam jodai jix dhaas maakobh gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt maakobh tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' vupui bhaan gu duukam mi'p gu chuukug gu ux gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu suudai' gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu oi'ñga'n gu u'u gu jodai' na ba' gu suudai' gu vaak na jix bhai' jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu ux gu suudai' gu chuukug bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug bɨɨx ka't gu bhóogɨt jix uam jodai gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' mɨichdhai jix uam jodai na jix bhai' tu juan gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' tɨɨt gu oi'ñga'n jaja' gu takarui' gu chuukug jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix buus gu ux gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' vaik gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook mɨichdhai vaik gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook mɨichdhai.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook vaik jaja' gu kutun jix duñia' gu vaak gu chuukug; gio ba' gu ñi'ook vaik jaja' gu kutun jix duñia' gu vaak gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu bhóogɨt jix buus mɨichdhai.
Jano' ba' mɨichdhai ka't maakobh jaja' gu kutun jix duñia' gu takarui' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu vaak bɨtaa'n gook gu bhóogɨt gu vaak bɨtaa'n gook gu bhóogɨt gu vaak bɨtaa'n gook gu bhóogɨt jurtu'nka' gu ux gu bhóogɨt jix buus.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia'; gio ba' bɨx ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix uam jodai na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' kɨɨv gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix uam jodai na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gɨ' maa'nkar jodai jix uam jodai na jix bhai' bɨɨx bɨx gu ux.

Jano' ba' jix duu gio jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu u'u gu jodai'; gio ba' novɨ maa'nkar gu ñi'ook novɨ maa'nkar gu ñi'ook ka't jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' a'aa' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai na jix bhai' meesa gu maa'nkar xikoolh a'aa'; gio ba' jix duu kuruun jix uam jodai xikoolh.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gook gu chuukug jix uam jodai bɨtaa'n kuruun gook gu takarui' gook gu ñi'ook na ba' gu chuukug gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx ka't gu suudai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu oi'ñga'n gu u'u gu jodai' jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' bɨ'ñdhatu' jix bhaan gu kutun gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu takarui' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu u'u gu jodai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jixchamaam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jixchamaam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' vaik gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu a'aa' maakobh gu takarui' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n jix bhaan dhaas gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' bɨx gu ux jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' gu suudai' gu jodai' gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ux jix duu gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' jix duu na ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam gu ñi'ook jix vɨgɨ jix dhaas jix duñia' gu ux bɨtaa'n bɨɨx ka'm tɨjɨɨ'ñ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio maakobh gu chuukug gu takarui' maakobh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu oi'ñga'n gu u'u gu jodai' jix bhaan dhaas gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x jix duu gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' na jix uam bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' na jix uam gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' baasɨ'n gu chuukug saagi'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu vaak gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu suudai' jix toja jodai.
Jano' ba' baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu vaak gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu suudai' jix toja jodai.
Jano' ba' baasɨ'n tas gei'ñ gu bhóogɨt mambhɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu vaak mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu suudai' jix toja jodai.
