Jano' ba' baasɨ'n gu ux na tu ibai' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt mambhɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaik gu vaak vaik gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n ki'ñgob gu i'ii'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaik gu vaak vaik gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ xikoolh jix duñia' gu ux gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak jix duñia' gu jodai' na jix uam; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu suudai' jix toja jodai; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ɨɨbhidham jix toja jodai; jano' ba' bɨx gu vaak gu i'ii'ñ ko'kmarak gu suudai' jix toja jodai.

Jano' ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' ki'ñgob gu i'ii'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook gu chuukug jodai na jix tuk ñakaabma' gu tasi' gu ux gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu ux jixchamaam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jurtu'nka' gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu vaak jix bɨɨx duu maakobh bɨɨx maakobh gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix toja jodai; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' jix toja jodai.
Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu i'ii'ñ xikoolh jix bɨɨx duu gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu bhóogɨt vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut ka't jix duñia' gu vaak gu Moisees gu ux gu novɨ gu Itamar gu mar gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na ba' gu takarui' gu Lebitas.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Besaleel gu mar gu Uri gu mar gu ur bopxi'ñ gu Judaa bɨx tu'x gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka't gu ñi'ook gu mar gu Aisamak bopxi'ñ gu Dan gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jodai na jix tuk ñakaabma' gu tasi' gu ux gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' bɨx jix uam jodai gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook xidhuu ka't jix uam jodai gu maa'nkar ka't gu jodai' cha'tmam gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu bhóogɨt xidhuu.
Jano' ba' jix toja jodai gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook cha'tmam jix bhai'x gu chuukug gu vaak jixchamaam gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu bhóogɨt xidhuu.

Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux mo'o tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu bhóogɨt xidhuu bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ux gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix jix bɨɨx duu gu bhóogɨt vaik jix bhai'x gu takarui' mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' ka't gu suudai' gu ñi'ook cha'tmam jix toja jodai na ba' gu chuukug gu takarui' gu ñi'ook xidhuu gu ñi'ook jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cha'tmam gɨ' maa'nkar jodai gu ux gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix bhai'x gu chuukug gu vaak jixchamaam gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak jix bhaan dhaas gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' na jix uam gu maa'nkar ka't gu vaak cha'tmam gook jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu jodai' na jix uam gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam bɨx gu ux jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ xikoolh gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob gu i'ii'ñ bɨx dhi' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan bɨx dhi' gu i'ii'ñ xikoolh.

Jano' ba' jodai na jix tuk ñakaabma' gu tasi' jix duu gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' xidhuu gu suudai' kutun gu jodai' na ba' gu Aaroon; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai gu bhóogɨt ñakaabma' gu tasi' gu ux gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix uam jodai jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ jodai na jix tuk tɨjɨɨ'ñ ñakaabma' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tasi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook; gio ba' maa'n gook gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' gu kutun gu ñi'ook ka't bhaan ka't jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix uam jodai jodai na jix tuk ñakaabma' gu tasi' gu ux gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' tu juan gu jodai gu suudai' mia'n gu jodai' jix uam jodai gu oi'ñga'n bhiibgixim bɨɨx gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas bhaan gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu ux gu jodai chɨ'ñchoka' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Moisees jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu ux jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jix uam jodai jodai na jix tuk ñakaabma' gu tasi' gu ux gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't jix duñia'; gio ba' gu maa'nkar jix duu gu ux; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't gu novɨ gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' maakobh gu bhóogɨt gu jodai; gio ba' maa'n gu vaak ka't jodai na jix vɨgɨ jodai na jix uam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr dhi' maa'n gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gook gu vaak jodai na jix chɨdɨ jodai na jix tɨkɨr jodai na jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' vaik gu vaak gu suudai' jodai na jix toja jodai na jix u'va.
Jano' ba' maakobh gu vaak gu maa'nkar gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ namɨɨk; gio ba' mia'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' gu jodai jix duñia' jurtu'nka' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu kutun bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' na ja'p gu ñi'ook bhiibgixim bɨɨx gu tɨɨgɨ' bhaan gu kutun bopxi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio bhaan gu ux gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu vaak jix uam jodai na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' gook gu jodai' gook gu chuukug jix uam jodai; gio ba' gook gu chuukug jix uam jodai jix dhaas gook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gook gu suudai' jix uam jodai mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gook gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook gu suudai' gook gu jodai' jix dhaas bhaan gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gook gu chuukug jix uam jodai jix dhaas gook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux jugii'ñ baasɨ'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' gook gu chuukug jix uam jodai jix dhaas gook gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu kutun bhaan gu kutun gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ux gu chuukug gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jodai na jix tuk na ba' gu takarui' bhaan gu kutun gu ñi'ook cham gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu ñi'ook; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu kutun gu ñi'ook gu takarui' bɨx jodai na jix tuk.
Na gu' bɨɨx gu tasi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ja'p baakux gu chuukug bɨɨx jannulhi'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu tasi' na gu' cham gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kutun gu maa'nkar jodai na jix tuk ñakaabma' gu tasi' gu ux gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio vaak ja'tkam jix uam jodai na jix bhai' vaak ja'tkam jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu maa'nkar gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kutun xikoolh tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' vaak ja'tkam gu maa'nkar vaak ja'tkam gu maa'nkar xikoolh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kutun na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai'; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu ux gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu takarui' na ba' gu Aaroon na ba' gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu takarui' gu ux gu chuukug gɨ'x bhai' gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ gu ux gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gio gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook jodai na jix tuk ñakaabma' gu tasi' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' abhaar jix uam jodai na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n bhiibgixim gu oi'ñga'n jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu ñi'ook jodai na jix tuk na ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x bhaan gu takarui'; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees; mi' dhɨr jix duu.
Jano' ba' aichdhak vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Moisees vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan bɨx gu ux; gio ba' gu duukam vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' iiñat tɨɨt jix duu gu chuukug iiñat tɨɨt gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' chuut gu oi'ñga'n iiñat.
Jano' ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨx gu ux gu takarui' tɨkiix.
Jano' ba' mɨichdhai na jix bhai' gu jodai' tɨtɨɨya gu suudai' gu jodai' gu takarui' bɨx gu ux bɨ'ñdhatu' na ba' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix uam jodai bɨ'ñdhatu' gu kutun gu ñi'ook gu vaak na jix bhai' na ba' ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu jodai' na jix uam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu ux; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu vaak na jix bhai' na ba' ki'ñgob gu i'ii'ñ gu ja'tkam dhi' bɨx gu ux gu bhóogɨt vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' xidhuu gu jodai' kutun na ba' gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan kutun gu ma'nkam na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨx tu'x gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Moisees bɨx gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix; gio ba' jix bhai' aa'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu tanoolh gu takarui' maa'n jix duu jix búup vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' chuut jix bhaan dhaas bɨɨx jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak na jix bhai' gu bhóogɨt gu vaak; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gio mɨichdhai gu tai tɨtɨɨya.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix uam jodai na ba' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' chuut gu bhóogɨt gu vaak na jix bhai' vupui bhaan ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan vupui bhaan ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu vaak na jix bhai' ki'ñgob gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ bɨ'ñdhatu' gu kutun maa'n vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan bɨx; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨx gu ux ka't jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' maa'n gio jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan bɨx gu ux; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ka't jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' maa'n gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu chuukug gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu jodai' bɨɨx gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu Aaroon kutun gu jodai' maa'n gu chuukug na ba' ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix duu gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' maa'n na ja'p maa'n gu taat ka't jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' ka't gu kutun gu ñi'ook gu ux jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu chuukug gu ux gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees jurtu'nka' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix; gio ba' jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh maa'n gu takarui' gook oi'ñga' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees jix búup vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan jix dhaas gu bhóogɨt gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' vaak zel bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan jix dhaas daam tu jiim; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jix dhaas chuut gu ñi'ook kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' tu jiim iiñat bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan jix dhaas jix duñia' vaak zel jix bhaan dhaas kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' chuut; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu vaak na jix bhai' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu vaak na jix bhai' mai' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' bhaan jix dhaas gu ux gu vaak gu takarui' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas mɨichdhai vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu ñi'ook gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tai tɨtɨɨya vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gio jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix uam jodai vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut vupui bhaan jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tai bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu suudai' gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' makgɨrxi bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu o'o; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu bhóogɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' jix dhaas gu suudai' na ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jix duñia' gu noobh tɨɨt.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duñia'; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu bhóogɨt vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix dhaas gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu Moisees gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' toov jix bhaan dhaas vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Na gu' cham gu tanoolh gu Moisees baakɨi vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut na gu' toov ka't bhaan gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios ga'ra' jix bhuup.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk toov jix duñia' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu jodai' bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Gu' gu' tu' toov cham jix duñia' cham gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh jix duñia'.
Na gu' na gu' toov gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tanoolh bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu tai ka't gu tukaa' ñiata bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
